text: A3lana yawm al-ithnayn, 3ulama2 min kulliyat al-tib bi-jami3at Stanford, 3an i5tira3 adat tash5isiyya jadida yumkinuha farez al-5alaya 7asab annaw3: w hiya 3ibara 3an shari7a sa8ira qabila lil tiba3a yumkinu tasni3aha bisti5dam tabi3at 7ibriyya muqabel 7awali sant amriki li-kollen minha.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Yaqulu al-ba7ithun inna hadha al-iktira3 qad yanja7 fi al-kashef al-mubakker 3an assaratan wa ssil wa virus naqs al-mana3a wal malarya lil marda fil buldan mun5afidat adda5el, 7aythou yumkin an takun mu3addalat al-baqa2 3ala qayd al-7ayat li-amrad mithil saratan athadiy nisif tilka al-mawjuda fil buldan al-8aniya.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Ta7attamat ta2irat JAS 39C Gripen wa nfajarat 3ala madraj fi 7awali assa3a al 9:30 saba7an bil tawqit al-ma7aliy (0230 bi-tawqit al-3alami), mimma adda ila i8laq al-matar amam  arri7lat al-jawiya attijariya.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Tamma at-ta3aruf 3ala a66ayyar 3ala annahu qa2id as-sirib Dilokrit Pattavee.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Wa naqalat was2el i3lam ma7aliyya anna sayrat intifa2 inkalabat fi al-matar athna2 al-qiyam bi-3amaliha.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Indamma Vidal dhou 28 3aman ila fariq Barchalona qadiman min Ishbaliya.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: La3iba Vidal 49 mubaratin mudhu qudumihi ila al-3asima al-Kataloniyya.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Indala3at al-i7tijajat na7wa al-se3a al 11:00 bi-al-tawqit al-ma7ali (bi-al-tawqit al-3alami al-muwa77ad +1) fi Whitehall muqabel madkhal Downing Street al-ladhi ta7rushu al-shorta, haythu maqar ra2is al-wuzara2 arra2isi.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Ba3da al-sa3a al 11:00, qata3a al-mu7tajjun al-tariq amama 7amilat naqel mutajiha na7wa shamal.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Fi sa3a al 11:20, talabat al-shorta mina al-mutazahirin al-3awda ila rasif, mushiratan ila annahum bi-7ajaten ila al-muwazana bayna al-7aq fi al-i7tijaj wa dabet 7arakat al-murur.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Fi 7awali al-sa3a al 11:29, intaqalat al-i7tijajat ila Whitehall, mururan bi-midan Trafaglar 3ala toul Strand, mururan bi-Aldwych waKingsway bi-tijah Holburn, haythu kana 7izib al-mu7afizin ya3qidu muntada arrabi3 fi fondok Grand Connaught Rooms.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Wasal sijil al-muwajahat al-mubashara bayna Nadal wa nazirih al Kamadiy ila 7-2 li sale7 Nadal.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Wa qad khasira mu2akharan amama Raonic fi iftita7iyat Brisbane.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Wa qad 7asala Nadal 3ala 88 bil mi2a min al-niqat al-safiya fi al-mubarat wa faza bi-76 noqta fil ersal al-awwal.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Ba3da al-mubarat, qala malik al-mala3ib atturabiyya:”ana muta7ammisun lil 3awda fil jawlat al-akhira min hadhal 7adath al-muhim. Wa innani huna lil fawz.
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: Yuqsadu bi-“watha2iq Panama” 3ashru malayin wathiqa min asharika al-panamiya al-qanuniyya Mossack Fonseca al-lati tasarabt lil sa7afa fi rabi3 2016.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Wa azharat al-watha2iq arba3ta 3ashar bankan sa3adat al-3umala2 al-aghniya2 fi ikhfa2 milyarat al dolar li taharrob min adara2ib wa al-anzima al-ukhra.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Za3amat jaridat The Guardian al-britaniyya anna bank Deutsche yusayter 3ala thuluth min 1200 sharikat wahmiyya li ta7qiq dhalik.
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Indala3at al-i7tijajat fi kol an7a2 al-3alam, wa 3iddat mu7akamat jina2iya, wa staqala kol min ru2asa2 7ukumatay Islanda wa Pakistan.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Wulida Ma fi Hong Kong, wa darasa fi jami3at New York wa fi kuliyyat al-7uquq fi jami3at Harvard, wa 7asala 3ala al-bitaqa al-khadra2 al-Amrikiyya "bitaqat al-ikama adda2ima".
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Wa alma7a Hshieh khilal al-intikhabat ila anna Ma qad yafiru mina al-bilad fi awqat al-azma.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Wa za3ama Hshiesh anna Ma, dhou al-mazhar al-7asan, kana shaklan akhtar min kawnihi jawharan.
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Bi-raghami min hadhihi al-tuham, faza Ma bi-suhulatin 3ala minasatin tad3u ila tawtid al-3alaqat ma3a Sin al-qarriya.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: La3eb mubarat al-yawm huwa Alex Ovechkin min fariq Washington Capitals.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: Sajjala hadafayen wa sahama fi hadafayen akharayan daminan al-fawz li fariqihi Washington bi 5 ahdaf muqabel 3 doda fariq Atlanta Thrashers.
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Wa kanat al-tamrira al-7asima al-ula fi muabarat al-layla min Ovechkin hiya hadaf al-fawz al-ladhi sajalahu Nicklas Backstrom;
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Wa kana hadafahu al-thani fi al-mubarat huwa al-hadaf raqam 60 fi hadha al-mawasem li yusbi7a awal la3eb yusajjel 60 hadafan aw akthar fi mawsamin wa7ed mudhu 1995-96 muta3adilan bi-dhalika ma3a Jagr wa Mario Lemieux al-ladhayn 7aqaqa hadha al-raqam fi dhalika al-waqet.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: I7talla Batten al-martaba 190 fi qa2imat aghna 400 amrikiyyan li 3am  2008 bi-tharwatin tuqadaru bi-na7wi 2.3 milyar dolar.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: Takharraja Batten min kulliyat al-funun wal 3ulum bi-jami3at Virginia 3am 1950 wa kana sharafan 3azimanli tilka al-mu2asasa.
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: 2u'9rimat al-niran fi sijn 2abu '3rib al-3ira8i 5ilal a3mal 4a'3ab.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Wa sa2at sum3at al-sijin ba3da iktishaf sou2 mu3amalat al-sujuna2 ba3da tawali al-quwwat al-amarikiyya li zimam al-2umur.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Istadama Piquet Jr. fi sibaq ja2izat Sangafora al-kubra 3am 2008 ba3da tawaquf mufaje2 li Fernando Alonso, mimma adda ila ikhraj sayarat al-aman.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Wa 3indama twajahat al-sayarat al-lati kanat amama Alonso lil 7usul 3ala ak-wuqud ta7ta sayyarat al-aman, tamkkana Alonso mina al-fawz.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: 2uqila Piquet Jr. ba3da ja2izat al-majar al-kubra 3am 2009.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Fi tamam al-sa3a 8:46 saba7an, khayyama assamet 3ala al-madina, mushiran ila la7zat dareb al-ta2ira al-ula li hadafiha.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Tamma ida2at shu3a3ayn lil ishara ila assama2 athna2a al-layl.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Yajri al-3amal 3ala bina2 khams nati7at sa7ab jadida fi almawqi3, m3a wujud markaz muwasalat wa 7adiqa tizkariya fi al-muntasaf.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: 7asala 3ard PBS 3ala akthar min 3ishrin ja2izat Emmy, wa kanat muddat 3arduhu aqal min Sesame Street wa Mister Roger's Neighborhood.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Wa fi kul 7alqa sawfa yatimmu al-tarkiz 3ala mawdu3 min kitab mu3ayyan min thamma yatem 3ared al-mawdu3 khilal 7alaqatin muta3adida.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Wa sawfa yuqaddimu kul 3ared tawsiyatin li kutubin yab7athu 3anha al-atfal fi al-maktabat.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: Wa qala John Grant 3abra ma7att WNED Buffalo (khilal al-barnamaj al-telefizyoniy Rainbow’s home station) inna barnamej Reading Rainbow yu3allem al-atfal kayfiyat al-qira2a…wa 7ob al qira2a -[al-barnamaj] yushaje3 al-atfal 3ala ikhtiyar kitaban wa qira2atih.
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Ya3taqed al-ba3ed, bi-ma fi dhalika John Grant, anna azmat al-tamwil wa naqla annaw3iyya fi falsafat al-baramej al-telefizyoniyya attarbawiya addat ila inha2 al-musalsal.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Wa yaqulu khubura2 al-arsad inna al-3asifa, al-lati taqa3 3ala na7uw (1040 kilometer)  ghareb juzur Cape Verde, mina al-arja7 an tatabaddad qabla il7aq al-darar bi-ay mintaqa.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Tablughu sur3at i3sar Fred 105 milan bi-sa3a wa yatajih na7wa al-shamal al-gharbi.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred huwa aqwa i3sar istiwa2i tamma tasjiluh 3ala al-itlaq januban wa sharqan fi al-mu7it al-atlasi munthu thuhur suwar al-aqmar al-sina3iya, wa thalith i3sar kabir faqat tama tasjiluh sharqan bi zawiyat 35 daraja gharban.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Fi 24 September/aylul 3am 1759, waqqa3a Arthur Guinness 3aqid ijar li mudat 9000 sana ma3 Sant James Gate Brewery  fi Dublin fi  Irlanda.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Wa ba3da 250 3aman, ta7awalat Guinness ila sharika 3alamiya tadirru akhtar min 10 milyarat yoro (ay ma yu3ad 14.7 milyar dolar amriki) kul 3am.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Laqd da5al Juni Riid al-qa2id al-musharik lifariq a1 nyuziland at-tari5 al-ywm min 5ilal qiyadatih al-asra3 3ala jisr marfa2 2awkland binyuzilnda al-lathy yablu'3 min al-3umr 48 3aman bishkl qanuni.
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Wa tamakkana al-sayed Reid min qiyadar al-sayyara al-nyouzlandiyya A1GP 3ala al-jiser sabe3 marrat bi-sur3atin tazid 3an 160 kilometer bil sa3a.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Wajahat al-shorta al-nyuzalandiyya mushkilatan fi istikhdam banadeq al-radar al-sari3a li ma3rifat mada al-sur3a al-lati yasir biha Reid bi-sabab inkhifad mustawa sayarat Balck Beauty. Wa tamakant al-shorta min dabet sor3at al-sayed Reid li mara wa7ida 3endama khafafa sur3atuhu ila 160 kilometer bi-sa3a.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Tamma itlaq sara7 akthar min 80 mu3taqilan fi munsha2at Central Booking fi al-ashhor al-thalatha al-madiya, dun tawjih tuham rasmiyya ilayhem.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Fi Abril/nisan min hadha al-3am, asdara al-qadi Glynn amran mu2aqatan bil sijin al-mu2aqat dodda al-mansha2a li fard itlaq sara7 al-mu7tajazin ba3da akthar min 24 sa3a min qubulihim wa la-dhin lam ya7sulu 3ala jalsat istima3 min qibali mufawwad al-ma7kama.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Yu7aded al-mufawwed al-kafala, fi 7al man7iha, wa yudfi al-tabi3 arrasmi 3ala al-tuham al-lati yuwajihuha al-dabet al-ladhi qama bil i3tiqal. Thumma yatim idkhal arrusum fi nidham al-7asoub al-khas bil wilaya haythu yatem tatabo3 al-7ala.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Kama tu7added jalsat al-istima3 tarikh 7aq al-mushtabah fih fi mu7akama sari3a.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Alqa amin al-khizana al-ustrali al-sayed Peter Costello da3mahu li sina3at al-taqa al-nawawiyya fi Australia. W min al-murajja7 an yakhluf al-sayed Costello ra2is al-wuzara2 John Howard ka-za3im lil 7izb al-librali.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Wa qala Costello innahu yajeb 3ala Australia an tuwasel istikhdam al-taqa al-nawawiyya fi 7al asba7a tawlid hadhihi al-taqa mujdiyan iktisadiyyan.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Wa adafa Costello:”wa fi 7al asba7at hadhi al-taqa muta7a lil bay3, fa yajib an na7sul 3alayha, ay laysa hunaka ay i3tirad 3ala al-taqa al-nawawiyya min 7aythu al-mabda2”.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Wa bi 7asb Ansa, sha3arat al-shurta bi al-qalaq min darbatayn 3ala mustawa 3ali khashyat 2an tush3al 7arban shamila 3ala al-khilafa.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Wa qalat al-shorta inna Lo Piccolo kana yamluk al-a8labiya,idh annahu kana  al-yad al-yumna li Provenzano fi Palermo, wa qad aksabathu khibratuhu al-wasi3a i7tiram al-jil al-akbar sinan min arru2asa2 athna2 itiba3ihim li siyasat Provenzano al-mutamathila fi al-7ifaz 3ala adna mustawa mumkin ma3 ta3ziz shabakat al-taqa al-khassa bihim.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Wa qad kaba7a Provenzano jima7 ha2ula2 arru2asa2 bi-wad3i 7addan lil 7arb al-lati qadatha Riina dod al-dawla al-lati awdat bi-7ayat rajulay al-mafya al-salibiyya Giovanni Falcone wa Paola Borsellino fi 3am 1992.
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Kashafa Steve Jobs, arra2is al-tanfizi li sharikat Apple, 3an al-jihaz khilal sayrihi 3ala al-minassa wa ikhrajihi min jayb al-jinz al-khas bihi.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Wa sarra7a Jobs khilala khitabihi al-ladhi istaghraqa sa3atayn sarra7a bi-anna al-yawm sa-tu3id ikhtira3 al-hatif min jadid wa sa-nasna3 al-tarikh al-yawm.
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Tu3tabar al-Barazil akbar dawla kathulikiyya rumanniya 3ala wajeh al-ared, wa qad 3aradhat al-kanisa al-rumaniyya al-kathulikiyya bi-stimrar idfa2 al-shar3iyya 3ala zawaj al-mithliyyin fil bilad.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Naqash al-kongres al-watani lil Brazil idfa2 al-shar3iyya li mudat 10 sanawat, wa mithla hadha zawaj al-madani yu3tabar 7aliyan qanuniyyan faqat fi Rio Grande do Sul.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Tammat siyaghat mashru3 al-qanun al-asli min qibal 3umdat Sao Paola al-sabiq, Marta Suplicy. Wa asba7a al-tashri3 al-muqtara7 ba3da ta3dilihi
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Ya2mal al-mu7tajjun fi jam3 3arida min 1.2 malyon tawqi3 li taqdimiha ila al-kongres al-watani fi November/tishrin al-thani.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Ba3da an asba7a wadi7an anna al-3adid mina al-3a2ilat kanat tab7ath 3an musa3ada qanuniyya li mukafa7at 3amaliyat al-ikhla2, tamma 3aqid mu2tamar fi 20 Maris/ adhar fi markaz qanun al-mujtama3 al-sharqi lil khalij li da7aya 3amaliyat i7tiyal al-iskan.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: wa 3indama bada2a al-musta2jirun fi musharakt ma 7adatha lahum, iktashafat aghlab al-3a2ilat al-ma3niya anna Crolyn Wilson min hay2at al-eskan fi Oakland (OHA) qad saraqat wada2i3 al-ta2min al-khassa bihim wa harabat min al-madina.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Ya3taqid al-musta2jirun fi Lockwood Gardens anna akthar min 40 3a2ila qad tuwajih al-ikhla2, hayth 3alimu bi anna shurtat OHA tu7aqiq aydan fi mumtalakat al-eskan al-3am fi Oakland al-lati qad takun mutawarrita fi 3amaliyat i7tiyal al-eskan.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Laqad alghat al-firqa 3ardaha fi mal3ab al-7arb al-tidhkari fi Maui, wa ladhi kana min al-muqarrar an ya7duruhu 9000 shakhsan. Wa qad qaddamat al-firqa i3tidhariha lil jamahir.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Lam tuqaddim sharikat idarat al-firqat , HK Management, sababan awwaliyyan 3indama 2ulghiya al-7afel fi 20 September/aylul , lakinaha fil yawm al-tali tagharra3at bi asbab lujastiyya.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Sujina al-mu7amiyyan al-yunaniyyan al-mashhuran, SakisKecgagioglou wa Jorj Nikolakopoulos fi sijin Korydallus bi-2athina , haythu tammat idanathuma bil kaseb ghayr al-mashru3 wal fasad.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Natijatan li dhalik, uthirat fadi7a kubra dakhil al-mujtama3 al-yunani ba3da al-kashef 3an al-ijra2at ghayr al-qanuniyya al-lati qama biha al-qudat wal mu7amun wa katibu al-3adel khilal al-sanawat al-madiya.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Wa ba3da asabi3 qalila, ba3da an nasher al-khabar fi barnamaj al-sa7afiy Makis Truantafylopoulos al shahir "Zoungla" wa ladhi yu3rad 3ala qanat Alpha TV, tamma tana7i 3uduw al-barlaman wal mu7ami Petros Mantouvalos bi-sabab tawarrut a3da2 maktibihi fi jara2im fasad ghayr mashru3a.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: 3alawatan 3ala dhaliki, tamma sajen al-qadi al-kabir Evangelos Kalousis ba3da ma tammat idanatuhu bo-jara2em fasad wa suluk mun7at.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Bada2at 2al 2e7tefalat bi 3ared 5as li majmu3at Cirque Du Soleil al-lati ta7mel shuhra 3alameyya.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: La8ad tabi3atha 2urkistra al-dawlat al-symfwnya fy Is6nbwl wahiya fir8at Enkishariya walmughanniyan Fati7 Erkwatsh wa Muslwm Ghwrsys.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Thumma 2e3tala Dervishes 2al Raqes 2al masra7.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: 8addamat al-mughanniya al-turkiya Syzyn Aksu 3ar'9an ghina2yan ma3 al-tynwr al-ey6aly Alysandrw Safyna walmughany al-yunany Harys Alyksw.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: 5etaman, qaddamt ferqat 2al raqs 2al Turkeyya "nar 2al 2anadol" , 3ard "Terwada".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Tuwuffeya Peter Lenz, 2a7ad 2al mutasabeqeen fi reyadet 2al darrajat 2al nareyya wa ladhi yablogh min 2al 3omr 13 3aman, ba3da ta3arrodihi li 7adeth tasadom fil tareeq assari3 fi Indianapolis Motor.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Saqata Lenz min fawq darrajatihi 2athna2 fatrat 2al 2e7ma2, thumma sadamahu zamiluhu 2al mutasabeq Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Tammat mu3alajetuhu 3ala 2al fawr min qebal 2al taqem 2al tobbe 2al mutanaqqel wa tamma naqluhu 2ela mustashfa ma7alli 7aythu tuwuffiyya la7iqan.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Lam yata3arrad Zayat lel 2esaba fi 2al 7adeth.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Wa fi ma yata3allaq bel wadh3 al-mali al-3alami, estatradda Zapatero qa2ilan inna "al-nidham al-mali huwa juz2un asasiyyun min al-eqtisad.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Wajahna azama maliyya estamarrat li muddat 3am, wa balaghat la7dhataha al-3asibah al-7alqoum 5ilal al-shahrayn al-madiyayn, wa a3taqidu anna al-aswaq al-maliyya bada2at al-2an bil ta3afi.
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Fil 2usbu3 al-madi, a3lana al-barnamaj al-talfezyoniy Naked News bi annahu sayazid bi shakl kabir min tafwidihi li estekhdam al-lughat al-dawaliyya wa 2idafatiha ila al-taqarir al-e5bariyya, bi thalath 3amaliyyat bath nasharat e5bariyyah jadida.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Taqumu al-munadhama al-3alamiya bi taqdim al-taqarir bi al -lughatayn al-Engliziyya wal Yabaniyya, wa tutliqu barnamajan bil lugha al-Esbaniyya wal Italiyya wal Kuriyya, lil television, wa mawqe3 al-web, wal ajhiza al ma7mula.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: li 7usun al-7az la yusebni ay shay2, lakinnani ra2ayt mashhadan murawwi3an, 7aythu 7awala annas ta7tim al-nawafedh min ajel al-khuruj.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Kana annas yadribuna al-alwa7 al-zujajiyya bil karasi, laken al-nawafedh la yumkinu kasruha.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: Wa qala Franciszek Kowal, a7ad al-najin, "enkasara a7ad alwa7 al-zujaj fi al-nihaya wa bada2ou bil 5ourouj min al-nafidha."
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Tutleq al-noujoum al-dhaw2 wal 7arara bi sabab al-taqah al-natijah 3inda ertibat aw endimaj dharrat al-hydrojen ma3an li tashkil 3anaser athqal.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Ya3mal al-3ulama2 3ala ensha2 mafa3el yumkunha entaj al-taqa bi nafs al-tariqa.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika fa hadhihi moushkila yas3ob 7alluha wa sa-tastaghreq sanawat 3eddah qabla an nara bina2 mufa3alat endimajiyya nafi3a.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Ta6fu al-ebra al fuladhiyya fawqa al-ma2 bi sabab al-tawattur al-sat7i.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Ya7duth al-tawattur al-sat7i li 2anna juzay2at al-ma2 al-mawjuda 3ala sate7 al-ma2 tanjadheb bi quwwah ila ba3diha al ba3edh akthar memma tanjadheb ila juzay2at al-hawa2 al-lati fawqaha.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Tushakkel juzay2at al-ma2 tabaqah ghayr mar2iyyah 3ala sate7 al-ma2, memma yasma7 li aghrad methla al-2ebra an ta6fu 3ala hadha al-sate7.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Al-shafra al-mawjuda 3ala tazaloj al-jalid al-7adith laha 7affah muzdawaja ma3 tajwif muqa33ar baynahuma. Tasma7 al 7afatan bi masek al-jalid bi shaklin afdal, 7atta 3enda al-imala.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Nadharan li anna al-juz2 al-sufli mena al-shafra mun7ani qalilan, 7aythu tamil al-shafra ila janib aw akhar, fa inna al-7affa al-mulamisa lil jalid tan7ani aydan.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Hadha al-amr yatasabab fi dawaran al mutazalej. Idha kanat al-zallajat ma2ilah na7wa al-yamin, fa enna al-mutazalej yastadir yaminan, w idha kanat tamil ila al yasar, yata7awwal al-mutazallej yasaran.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Lil3awda ela mustawa al-6a8a al-sabi8 lahum yajib an yatakhalla9u min al-6a8a al-2i'9afiya allaty 7a9alu 3alayha min al-'9aw2.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Taf3al dhalika bi esdar jusaym saghir min al dhaw2 yusamma al "foton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Yutleq al-3ulama2 3ala hadhihi al-3amaliyyah esim"al enbi3ath al-musta7ath lel esh3a3" nadharan li anna al-daw2 al sate3 ya7for al-dharah, memma yatasabab fi enbi3ath foton men al dhaw2, wal dhaw2 huwa naw3 min al-esh3a3.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Ta3rudh al-sura al-taliya al-dharra al-lati tanba3eth menha fotonat. Wa mina al-mu2akad anna al-fotonat fil waqe3 asaghar bi khathir min telka al-mawjudah fil sura.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Al-fwtwnat a9ghar min al-mada allaty tatakawan minha al-tharrat!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ba3da mi2at alsa3at mina altashghil, ya7tariq alfatil almawjud fi almisba7 fi alnihaya wa yatawaqaf almisba alkahraba2y 3an al3aml.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Hunaka 7ajah 2edhan li estebdal lambat al mesba7. Wa mina al darouriy tawa5i al 7adhar 3enda estebdal lambat al mesba7.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Awalan, yajib i8af tashghil mifta7 wa7dat al-i'9a2a aw fa9l al-kabil.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Yarji3u hadha ila anna al kahraba2 al-moutadafiqqah ila al meqbas 7ythama yathbut al juzu2 al ma3daniy min al mesba7 qad tu3ariduka li sadmah kahraba2iyya balighah idha lamasta al-juzu2 al-da5iliy min al meqbas aw al qa3idah al ma3daniyyah lel mesba7 baynama la yazal juzu2 menha fi al meqbas.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Al-3uduw arra2is fi jihaz al-dawra ad-damawiyya huwa al-qaleb al-ladhi yadhukh ad-dam.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Yadhhab ad-dam ba3idan 3an al-qalb fi anabib tusamma al sharayin wa ya3ud ila al qaleb fi anabib tusamma al awrida. Asghar al anabib tusamma al shu3ayrat al damawiyya.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Kanat asnan al triseratobs (triceratops) qadira 3ala sa7eq laysa faqat al awraq wa lakin 7atta al furu3 wal judhur shadidat as-salaba.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Ya3taqed ba3dh al 3ulama2 anna al Triceratops qad ta2kol al sikasyat, wa houwa naw3 min an-nabatat kana sha2i3an fil 3asr al-tabashiri.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Tabdu hadhihi an-nabatat wa ka2annaha shajarat na5il sa8irah dhat taj min al awraq al 7addah wal sha2ikah.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Kana mena lmoumken an tastakhdimaha al-Triceratops menqaraha al-qawiy li naz3 al awraq qabla akel al jidh3.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Yara 3ulama2 2a5arun bi anna hadhihi an-nabatat samma jiddan, lidha fa min ghayr al mourajja7 an ya2kulaha ay daynasur, 3ala al ru8m min anna 7ayawan al kaslan wa ghayraho mena al 7ayawanat methel al babbagha2(salil al daynasorat) yumkin an ta2kol al awraq aw al fakiha.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Kayfa sa tajdhibuni jadhibiyat lo? Idha waqafta 3ala sat7 lo, fa sayakun waznuka aqalu mimma howa 3ala al ared.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Ash-shaks al ladhi yazen 200 ra6el (90 kg) 3ala al ard yazinu 7awalay 36 ri6lan (16 kg) 3ala kawkab akhar lidha fa inna al jadhibiyya bil 6abe3 la tashudduka kathiran.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: La yujad lil shams qeshra methel al ard yumkinuku al wuquf 3alayha. Tatashakal al shams b akmaliha min al ghazat wal nar wal blasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Yu9bi7 al-ghaz a8al waznan kullama 2bta3adna 3an markaz al-shams.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Yusmma al-juz2 al-kharijy allathy narah 3indma nan'6ur ela al-shams basm al-fwtwsfyr wahuw ma yu89ad bih "haltu al-'9aw2".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ba3da 7awali thalathat alaf 3am, fi 3am 1610, estakhdama 3alem al falak al Italy Galilea Galilei al teleskob li mula7adhat 2anna kawkab al zuhra lahu a6war, tamaman mithil al qamar.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Ta7duth al a6war nadharan li2anna janeb kawkab al zuhra (aw al qamar) al muwajeh lel shams huwa al mudha2 faqat. Wa da3amat a6war kawkab al zuhra nadhariyyat Copernicus al lati tanussu 3ala anna al kawakeb tadouru 7awla al shams.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Waba3d thalik bibi'93 sanawat fy 3am 1639 la7'6a 3alim falak englyzy yud3a Ermya Hwrwks 3ubwr kawkab Al-zuhra.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: 3ashat Engeltera fatratan tawila min as-salam ba3da isti3adat Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, fa fi 3am 991 wajahat Ethelred ustulan min al viking akbar min ayyi 2ustul mundhu Guthurm qabla qarn min al zaman.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Kana hadha al 2ustul bi qiyadat Olaf Trygvasson, wa houwa muwaten Narwijiy ya6ma7 li esti3adat biladihi min al haymana al Danimarkiyya.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ba3da al intikasat al 3askariyya al awwliyya tamakkana Ethelred min al itifaq ma3a Olaf, al ladhi 3ada ila Al Narwij fi mu7awalatin li kasb mamlakatiha bi darajat mutafawita min al naja7.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Al Hanguel hiya al abjadiya al wa7ida al lati tamma ikhtira3uha 3an qasd fi al istekhdam al yawmi al sha3bi. Tamma e5tira3 al abjadiyya 3am 1444 fi 3ahd al malik Sejong (1418- 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Laqad kana al Malek Sejong rabe3 muluk Joseon wa howa a7ad akthar al muluk e7tiraman.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: 2utliqa fil asel 3ala abjadiyat al Hangeul isim Hummin Jeongeum, wa ma ya3ni "al aswat al sa7i7a li ta3lim an-nas".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Yujad al 3adid min al nadhariyyat tata3alaq bi kayfiyyat nushu2 al lugha al Sanskritiyyah. E7daha tata3alaq bi hijrat al Aryan min al ghareb ila al Hined, wa laqad jalabu lughatahom ma3ahom.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Al lugha al Sansikritiyya hiya lugha qadima wa yumkinu muqaranataha bil lugha al Latiniyya al musta5dama fi Orobba.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: katab a8dam kitab fy al-3alm tamma al-3uthwr 3alayhi ballughati alsynsikrytya. waba3d tajmy3 al-abanyshad talashat allugha al-synsikrytya bisabab al-tadaruj al-haramy.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Al lugha al Sansekritiyya hiya lugha mu3aqqada wa ghaniya lel ghaya kanat masdaran lel 3adid min al loughat al 7adithah, tamaman methla al Latiniyya wal lati tu3addu masdar al lughat al Eurobbiyya methel al Faransiyya wal Esbaniyya.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Ma3a entiha2 ma3rakat Faransa, 2a3addat Almanya 3iddataha li ghazuw al jazira al Britaniyya.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Atlaqat Almanya 3ala al hujum isim "3amaliyat asad al ba7er". Fuqidat mu3dham al asli7a al thaqila wal imdadat al lati kana yamtalikuha al jaysh al Britaniy 3enda ijla2ihi min Dunkirk, lidha kana al jaysh da3ifan ila 7adden ma.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Lakinna al ba7riya al malakiyya kanat la tazal aqwa bi kathir min al ba7riyya al Almaniya ("Kriegsmarine") wa kana bi imkaniha tadmir ay ustul ghazuw yatimmu ersalahu 3abra al qanat al Engliziyya.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, kana 3adad qalil jiddan min sufun al ba7riyya al malakiyya mutamarkizan bil qurb min turuq al ghazuw al mu7tamala 7aythu kana al amiral yakhshawna 2an yughriqahum hujum Almani jawwi.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Linabda2 bishar7 3an khu6a6 Iy6alya. la8ad kanat Iy6alya fy al-asas "al-sha8y8 al-9aghyr" li Almanya wa Al-yaban.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Kana ladayha jaysh da3if wa 2ustul ad3af, 3ala l raghem min annahom banaw arba3 sufun jadida qabla bi dayat al 7arb mubasharatan.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: tamaththalat al ahdaf al ra2isiyya al Italiyya fi al duwal al Afriqiyya. Lel saytara 3ala hadhihi al buldan, saya7tajun ila minassat etlaq lel quwat, 7atta tatamakan al quwat min al eb7ar 3abra al ba7r al abyad al moutawasset wa ghazuw Afriqya.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Li dhalika, kana 3alayhim al takhalus min al qawa3ed wal sufun al Britaniyya fi Mesir. Ila janeb hadhihi al ijra2at, lam yakun min al muftarad 2an taf3al al bawakher al Italiyya ay shya2 akhar.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Fil waqt al 7ali bil nesbah lel Yaban. Laqad kanat al Yaban e7da al buldan al jaziriyyah, tamaman methla Britanya.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Al ghawwasat hiya sufun musammama lel safar ta7ta al ma2, wa tabqa hunaka li fatra tawila men al-zaman.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Istu5dimat al ghawwasat fi al 7arb al 3alamiyya al 2ulah wal 7arb al 3alamiyya al thaniya. Fi dhalika al waqet kanu yattasimun bil bu6u2 al shadid wa kana nitaq ar-rimaya ma7dudan lil ghaya.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Fi bidayat nushub al 7arb, laqad safaru fi al ghaleb 3abra al ba7r, wa laken 3endama bada2a al radar fi al 6a6awwor wa asba7a akthar deqqatan, edh6arrat al ghawwasat ila al ghaws ta7ta al ma2 li tajannub ru2yataha.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kanat al ghawwasat al Almaniyya tusamma U-Boats. Kana al alman bari3in fi al tanaqqul wa tashghil ghawastihim.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Bi sabab naja7ihim ma3a al-ghawa9at, ba3d al-7arb, laysa min al-muftara'9 2an yakuna lada Al-alman al-kathir minha.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Na3am! Yu3addu al Malek Tutankhamun, wal ladhi yushar ilayhi a7yanan bi esm "al Malek Tut" aw "Al Malek al Sabiy"- a7ad ashhar muluk al masriyyin al qudama2 fil 3aser al 7adith.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Wa ma yastad3i al entibah fi dhalika huwa anna hadha al sha5es lam ya7dha bi ahamiyya baligha fil 3usur al qadimah wa lam yusajjal fi mu3zam qawa2em al muluk al qadimah.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, fa inna ektishafa qabrihi fi 3am 1922 ja3aluhu min al mashahir. Fi 7in tamma naheb al 3adid min al qubur al qadima, illa annahu lam yattem al 3abath bi hadha al qabr.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: 7ufidhat mou3dham al adawat al lati dufinat ma3a Tutankhamun bi tariqa jayyida, bi ma fi dhalika al alaf min al qita3 al athariyya al masnu3a min al ma3aden al tahminah wal a7jar al nadira.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ja3ala e5tira3 al 3ajalat dhat al siwar al 3arabat al 7arbiyya al Ashuriyya a5af waznan wa asra3 wa akthar este3dadan li mula7aqat al junud wal 3arabat al 7arbiyya al 2u5ra.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Yumkin an takhtariqa siham al aqwas al qatila duru3 al junud al mu3adiya. Bi 7ulul 7awali 1000 qabl al milad, qaddama al Ashuriyyun awwal sila7 fursan.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Sila7o al-fursan howa jaysh yo8atil 3ala '6uhur al-khayl. lam yakon al-sarj 8ad okhtori3a ba3d, lithalika 7araba al-fursan al-ashurioun 3ala '6uhur khyolihim al-3aria.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Na7nu na3rifu al 3adid min al siyasiyyin wal 3ulama2 wal fannanin al yunaniyyin. Rubbama yakun al sha5es al ashhar fi hadhihi al thaqafah huwa al sha3er al usturiy al a3ma Homerous, al ladhi allafa ethnayn min rawa2e3 al adab al Yunani wa huma: qasidatay al Iliad wa Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: La yazal Sophocles wa Aristophanes min al kuttab al masra7iyyin al mashhurin w tu3tabar masra7iyatihem min a3dham a3mal al adab al 3alami.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Yunani mashhur akhar huwa 3alem al riyadiyyat Pythagoras, al ma3ruf fi al ghalib bi nadhariyyatih al shahira 7awla al 3alaqah bayna adhlu3 al muthallathat al qa2ima.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Hunak ta8dyrat mutabayina 7awl 3adad al-ashkha9 allathyn yata7addathwn al-lughta al-hindiya. min al-mu8addar anna takwn bayn thany wa rabi3 akthar al-lughat allaty yata7addathu biha al-ashkha9 7awl al-3alam.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Yakhtalief 3adad al natiqin beha 7asab ma edha kana yatum 7isab al lahjat wathiqat al sila beha aw la.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Tatarawa7 al taqdirat min 340 milyon ila 500 milyon muta7addith, wa ma yasil ila 800 milyon shakhs yumkinuhum fahm al lugha.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Al Hendiyya wal Urdu mutashabihatan fil mufradat lakennahuma mukhtalifatan fil kitaba. Fil mu7adathat al yawmiyya, yumkin li muta7adithi kilta al lughatayn 3adatan fahem ba3dhihima al ba3dh.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Bi 7ulul al qarn al khames 3ashar, kanat shamal Estonya ta7ta ta2thir thaqafi kabir min Almanya.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Arad ba3'9 al-ruhban Al-alman ta8ryb ma3na al-elah min al-sukkan al-a9lyin lithalik akhtara3w al-lughata al-7arfiya al-estwnya.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Kana ya3tamed 3ala al abjadiyya al Almaniyyah wa 2u9ifa 7arf wa7ed "Õ / õ".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Ma3a murur al waqt, indamajat al 3adid min al kalimat al musta3ara min al Almaniyya. Kanat hadhihi bidayat attanwir.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Kan min al-ta8alyd al-muttaba3a al-ti7a8 waryth al-3arsh mubasharatan biljaysh ba3d takharujihi min al-madrasa.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Wa ma3a dhaleka, dhahaba Charles 2ela 2al jame3a fi kulliyat Trinity Cambridge 7aythu darasa 3ilim al-insan wa 3ilim al 2athar, wa tareekh la7eqan, wa 7asala 3ala 2:2 ( shahada min 2al daraja 2al thaneya 2al dunya).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Kana Tshharles awal fard fi al-3a2ila al-malika al-britaniya ya7sul 3ala daraja 3ilmiya.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turkiya 2al Orobbiyya (Traqya 2al sharqeyya 2aw Rumelya fe shebeh jazerat 2al balqan) tadhum 3% min 2al belad.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Yamtad toul 2al 2aradi 2al Turkiyya 2ela 2akthar min 1600 kilometer (1000 mil), baynama yamtad 3ardhuha ela 800 kilometer (500 mil) wa huwa ma yaj3aluha ta2khudh shakel 2al mosta6il.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Tablugh masa7at Turkiyya -bema fi dhaleka 2al bo7ayrat- 7awali 783,562 kilometran morabba3an (300,948 milan morabba3an), menha 755,688 kilometran morabba3an (291,773 milan morabba3an) fi janib gharb Asya, wa 7awali 23,764 kilometran morabba3an (9,174 milan morabba3an) fi Orobba.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Masa7at Turkiyya taj3aluha 2al dawla raqem 37 fil 3alam min 7aythu 2al masa7a, wa heya bi 7ajm Metropolitan France wal Mamlaka 2al Mutta7eda ma3an.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Ta7taden 2al be7ar turkeya min thalath jehat: ba7r 2eje min 2al gharb, 2al ba7r 2al 2aswad min 2al shamal, wal ba7er 2al mutawasset min 2al janub.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Ta7dha Luxembourg bi tare5 tawel laken ya3ud 2esteqlalaha 2ela 3am 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Kanat 2al manateq 2al 7aleyya min Baljeka juz2an min Luxembourg fil madi wa lakennaha 2asba7at Baljeka ba3d 2al thawra 2al Baljekeyya fi thalatheneyyat 2al qarn 2al tase3 3ashar.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: La talama 7awalat Luxembourg 2an tadhal dawla mu7ayeda, lakenna Almanya 2e7tallatha fil 7arb 2al 3alameyya 2al 2oula wal 7arb 2al 3alameyya 2al thaneya.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Fi 3am 1957, 2asba7at Luxembourg 3odwan mo2assesan fe al monazzama allate tu3raf al yawm be 2esm al ette7ad al Europiy.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Tumaththel Drukgyal Dzong e7da al qila3 al mu7atammah, wa hiya tadom dayran budhiy fil juz2 al 3elwiy min muqata3at Paro (fi qaryat Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Yudhkar annaho fi 3am 1649, ansha2a Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel al qal3a li 2e7ya2 dhekra entisarihi 3al quwat al Tibet al Mangoliyya.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Fi 3am 1951, tasabbaba 7ariq fi baqa2 ba3d athar Drukgyal Dzong, mithl surat Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Ba3da al 7ariq, tamma al 7ifadh 3ala al qal3a wa 7imayatiha, wa baqiyat wa7ida min akthar manatiq al jadhb itharah fi Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Khilal al qarn al thamin 3ashar, wajadat Kambodya nafsaha mu7asaratan bayn jaratayn qawiyatayn, Taylend wa Vyetnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Eqta7ama al Taylandiyyun Kambodya marrat 3adidah khilala al qarn al thamen 3ashar w fi 3am 1772 dammaru Phnim Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Fil sanawat al akhira min al qarn al thamen 3ashar ghaza al Vyetnamiyun Kambodya aydan.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Thamaniyata 3ashra fi al mi2a min al Venezueliyyin 3atiluna 3an l 3amal, wa ya3mal mu3zam 2ula2ika al ladhin ladayhem waza2ef fil eqtisad 8ayr al rasmi.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Thultha al Venezueliyin al ladhi ya3malun fi qita3 al khadamat ya3mal rub3ihim fi assina3a wa 5umsihim fi al zira3a.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Yu3tabar al naft min al sina3at al muhemma lil Venezueliyin, 7aythu tu3ad al dawla musadder safim 3ala al rughm min anna wa7id bil mi2a faqat ya3malun fi sina3at al naft.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Fi bidayat esteqlal addawla, sa3adat khebrat 7ada2eq Singafora annabatiyya fi ta7wil al jazira ila madinat 7ada2eq estiwa2iyya.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Fi 3am 1981, 2ukhtirat zahrat Nanda Miss Joaquim, wa hiya zahrat al Orchid al muhajjanah, li takun al zahra al wataniya lel bilad.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Fi kul 3am taqriban fi shaher teshrin al awwal, yusafer ma yuqareb min 1.5 milyon min akili  i al a3shab na7wa al suhul al janubiyya, 3abra nahr Mara, min al tilal al shamaliyya min ajl al amtar.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Thumma na3ud ila al shamal 3abra al gharb, maratan ukhra 3abra nahr Mara, ba3da hutul al amtar fi Naysan.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Tatadaman mentaqat Serengeti mutanazah Serengeti al wataniy, wa mentaqat ma7miyat Ngorongoro wa ma7miyat Maswa Game fi Tanzania wa ma7miyat Maasai Mara al wataniyya fi Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Enna 3amaliyat ta3alum ensha2 wasa2et tafa3uliya tatatalab mharat taqlidiyya wa mu3tadah, bil edafa ila adawatyajri dirasataha wa etqanaha fi al fusul al tafa3uliya (al qesas al musawwara wa ta7rir al sawt wal video wa riwayat al qesas wa ma ila dhalika).
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Yata6alab al-ta9mym al-tafa3uliy e3adta ta8yym aftra'9atik 7awl al-entaj al-e3lamy wata3allum al-tafkyr bi6uru8 ghayr kha6iya.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Yatatalb al tasmim al tafa3uliy an tatasl mukawinat al mashru3 bi ba3diha al ba3d, wa laken aydan yajeb an yujdi naf3an bi e3tibarihi kayanan munfasilan.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: 3ayb al 3adasat al muqarabah huwa anna al ta3qid al bari2 wa 3adad 3anaser al 3adasat- al matloubah li ta7qiq nitaq mu3ayyan min al atwal al ba2riyah- akbar bi kathir min al 3adasat al ra2isiyya.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Asba7at hadhihi mushkilah aqal idh yafi musani3u al 3adasat bi ma3ayir a3la fi entaj al 3adasat.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: 8ad sama7 thalik al-amr li3adasat al-mu8arraba bi2ntaj 9uwar bijuwda tu'9ahy tilk allaty 7a8a8atha al-3adasat that al-bu3d al-bu2riy al-thabit.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: 3ayb akhar li 3adasat al-takbir howa anna al-fat7a al-8u9wa (al-sur3a) lil 3adasat 3adatan ma takunu a8al.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Wa hadha al amr yaj3al min assa3b estekhdam al 3adasat al muqarraba al rakhisah fi zuruf al eda2a al munkhafida dun flash.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: yu3ad al khuruj 3n itar al shashah a7ad akthar al mushkilat shuyu3an 3nda mu7awalat ta7wil film ila tansiq DVD.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: tusna3 mu3zam ajhizat al telfaz bi tariqat erda2 al jumhur al 3am.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Li hadha al sabab, kullu ma tarah 3ala al telefizyon tamma qassuhu min a3la wa asfal wa min al jawaneb.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: 2ujriya dhalika lel ta2akud min anna al sura tughati al shashah bi akmaliha. Yusamma hadha al amr al khuruj 3an itar al shasha.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Li su2 al 7az, 3indama tastakhdem mushaghel aqras, fa sa taqta3 7awafahu aydan 3ala al arja7, w edha kana maqta3 al video yadom tarjamat shashah bi al qurb min al juz2 al sufliy lelghaya, fa innaha lan tazhar bil kamel.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: la zalat al qal3a al taqlidiyah fi al 3usur al wusta mulhimah lel 5ayal, wa esta7darat suwar al mubarazah wa ma2adem al ta3am wa al furusiyya al arthuriyya.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: 7atta 3enda al wuquf wasat atlal 3umruha alf 3amen, min alsahl tadhakur aswat wa rawa2i7 alma3arek al lati intahat mundhu fatra tawila, wa takad tasma3 qa3q3at al7awafir 3ala al7asa wa tashum ra2i7at alkhawf almutasa3id min 7ufar alzinzana.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: laken hal khayaluna qa2em 3ala al waqe3? Limadha tamma bina2 al qila3 fi al maqam al awal? Kayfa tamma tasmimuha wa bina2uha?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Min al 2umur al mu3tada 5ilal hadhihi al fatra e3tibar qal3at Kirby Muxloe manzilan mu7asanan min kawniha qal3ah 7aqiqiyyah.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Lam takun nawafthuha al-zyjajiya al-kabyra wajudraniha al-ra8y8a 8adira 3ala mu8awamati hujwm shadyd lawahadha fyh lifatarat 6awyla.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Fi al thamaniniyat min al qarn al tase3 3ashar, 3endama bada al Lord Hastings fi tashyidh, kanat al bilad tan3am bi ssalam nesbiyan wa kana al difa3 wajiban faqat ded majmu3ah sa8ira min al lusus al mutajawwilin.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Laqad kan mizan al quwa nidhaman sa3at fihi adduwal al Orobbiyaa ila al 7ifadh 3ala al siyada al wataniyya li jami3 adduwal al Orobbiyya.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Tamaththala al mafhum fi anna jami3 adduwal al-Orobbiya 3alayha as-sa3iy na7wa mane3 dawla wa7idah min an tosbe7 qawiyyah, wa 3ala hadha ghaliban ma kant al 7ukumah al wataniyyah tughayyir ta7alufatiha min ajel al 7ifadh 3ala  attawazun.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Kanat 7arb al-khilafati al-esbaniya hiya awala al-7urwb allaty kanat mshkilatuha al-asasiya hiya myzan al-8wa.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Kana hatha bimathabati taghyyr muhim eth lam ta3ud lada al-8uwa al-awrwbiya 7ijja tubarrir annaha 7urub diniya. itha satakwn 7arb al-thlathyn 3ama akhr 7arb tuw9af biannaha 7arb dinyia.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Ta3arrada ma3bad Artemis fi Efsus lil tadmer fi 21 tammuz 3am 356 qabl 2al melad ba3d 3amaleyyat e7raq al lati 2ertakabaha Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Wifqan lil qissa, kana dafi3uhu huwa ashshuhra bi 2ayyi thaman. 2a3lana 2al 2afsasiyyoun 2alghadibun 2anna 2ism Herostratus lan yusajjala abadan.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Dawwan al mu2arre5 2al Yunani Strabo la7eqan 2al 2esem bel shakel al ladhi  na3refuhu 7aleyyan, ta3arrad al ma3bad lel tadmer fil layla nafsaha al lati shahedat mawled Aleksander al 2akbar.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: 3ar'9a Al-Iskandar, bi sifatihi malikan, an yadfa3a mu8abil i3adati bina2 al-ma3bad, lakina 3ar'9ahu 8ubila birraf'9. fi wa8tin la7i8, ba3da wafati Al-Iskandar, u3ida bina2 al-ma3bad fi 3am 323 8abl al-milad.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Ta2akkad min 2an takun yadika mustar5eya qader al 2emkan fil 3azef 3ala jami3 addarajat al museqiyya bi shakel sa7ee7 -7awel aydan alla taqum bi 7araka ghareba bi asabe3ek.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Bihathihi al-6ary8a satujhid nafsak bia8al 8adr mumkin. tathakkar annahu laysat hunak 7ajatan lina8r 3ala al-mafaty7 bi8uwa kabyra lil7u9wl 3ala mustawa 9awt e'9afy min al-biyanw.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Lil 7osol 3ala 7ajem 2edafi min 2alat al akkordyon, yumkenuka 2este5dam manfa5 ma3 mazed min al daghet aw assur3a.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Attasawwuf huwa assa3iy wara2 attawasol al 3amiq aw al edrak al wa3i li 7aqiatin mutlaqa aw ilah aw 7aqiqa rou7iyya aw bil a7ra ma3a Al-Ilah.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Yab7ath al mu2men 3an tajruba aw fi6ra aw nazra thaqiba lil waqe3 al ilahiy / al ilah aw al aliha.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Yas3a al mutabi3un ila turoq mu3ayyana lil 3aysh, aw mumarasat tahdifu ila ri3ayat telka attajareb.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Yumkinu tamyiz attasawwuf 3an ghayrihi min al ashkal al u5ra lil mu3taqad addini wal 3ibada min 5ilal ta2kidihi 3ala attajruba al sha5siya al mubashara li 7ala min al wa3iy farida min naw3iha la siyyama al 7ala al lati tattasem bi taba3 selmiy, aw nafadh al basira, aw bi ssa3ada wa nna3im, aw 7atta al esteghraq fil ebtihaj al ghamer.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Asssi5iyya hiya diyana fi shebeh al qarra al hendeyya. Nasha2at fi mentaqat al Punjab 5ilal al qaren al 5ames 3ashar min enqesam ta2efe da5el attaqaled al Hendoseyya.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Ya3tabiru Assikhiyyun imanahum diyantan munfasila 3an al-Hendoseyya 3ala al rughem min 2e3terafehem bi judhur al-Hendoseyya wa taqalidiha.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Yotleq Assikhiyyun 3ala dinihim esem "Gurmat" wa heya kalema Benjabeyya ta3ni "tareqat al mu3allem". Yumaththel al morshed arru7i a7ad al jawaneb al asaseyya le jami3 al deyanat al hindeyya wa laken fi SSikhiyya 2ektasaba ahameyya tushakkel jawhar mo3taqadat As-sikh.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Ta2assasat hadhihi addiyana fil qaren al khames 3ashar 3ala yad Guru Nana (1469-1539). Wa qad 5alafahu 3ala ttawali tes3at mu3allimin 2a5arin.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Wa m3a dhalik, fi 7azeran 1956, wudi3at wu3ud Krushchev 3ala al mi7ak 3indama waqa3at a3mal shaghab fi Bolanda, 7aythu kana al 3ummal ya7tajjun 3ala naqs al ghidha2 wa khafd al 2ujur, wa ta7awwalat ila i7tijaj 3am didda ashhuyu3iyya.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Ta3tamid alru2ya aw alqudra 3la alru2ya 3la ala3dha2 al7isـsiya fi nizam alru2ya aw al3aynayn.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Hunaka al3adid min albinyat almukhtalifa lil 3uyun, wa tatarawa7 darajat t3qidiha 7asba i7tiyajat alka2in al7ay laha.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Tatamayyaz albinayat almukhtalifa bi qudrat mutanawi3a, kama annaha 7assasa li atwal almawjat almukhtalifa wa dhat darajat mutaghayira min al7idda, kama annaha ttatallab mu3alaja mukhtalifa li fahm almudkhalat wa al-arqam almukhtalifa lil 3aml 3ala afdhal na7w.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Asukkan hum majmu3at alka2inat al7aya min naw3 mu3ayan dakhil mintaqa jughrafiya mu3ayna.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: 3indama yashtarik jami3 al-afrad fi mujtama3in ma fi simat namatiya mu7addada, fa innahum yu3rifuna bi ism muwa7ady ashakl.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: 3indma yudhhir al-afrad 3iddat mutaghayirat li simat mu7addada, fa sayakunun mut3addidy alashkal.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Tasir musta3marat annaml wa tu3ashish fi mara7il mukhtalifa aydan.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Fi mar7alat attir7al yasir jaysh annaml laylan wa yatawaqaf 3an sun3 almukhayam athna2 annhar.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Yabda2 sakinu almust3mara fi mar7alat attir7al waqtama yaqil alghidha2 almuta7 laha. Wa ya3mal sakinu almusta3mara khilal hadhihi almar7ala 3la insha2 masـakin mu2aqqata, tataghayar yawmiyyan.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Tastamirru kullun min hadhihi althawarat aw almasirat li mudat 17 yawm taqriban.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Madha ta3ny al khaliya? Ta2ti kalimat "khaliya" mina alkalima allatiniya "cella", wal lati yuqsadu biha "ghorfa saghira", wa qad saghaha fi badi2 al2amr ikhtisasy maghary yuraqib tarkibat alfillin.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Al-khaliya hiya alwi7da alasasiya fi jami3 alka2inat al7aya, wa tatakawwan ajsam jami3 alka2inat al7aya min khaliya wa7ida aw akthar.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Tu3tabar alkhalaya asasiatan wa mu3aqada lil ghaya li dirasat al7ayat, fi alwaqi3, yushar ilayha ghaliban bi ism "allabanat al asasiya lil 7ayat".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Ya7afz algihaz al3asaby 3ala attawazun bi irsal nbadhat 3asabiya 3an tariq aljism lil 7ifaz 3ala tadaffuq addam duna 3a2iq.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Yumkin irsal hadhihi annabadat al3asabiya bi sur3a fi jami3 an7a2 aljism mimaa yusa3id fil 7ifaz 3ala aljism 2aminan min ayi tahdid mu7tamal.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Tadhrib al-a3asir misa7atan saghira muqaranatan bil 3awasif al3anifa al-ukhra, lakin yumkinuha tadmir kulli shay2 fi tariqiha.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Taqtali3 al-a3asyr al-ashjar, wa tanzi3 al-alwa7 min fawq almbany, wa taqdhif bi ssayarat n7w assama2. Tadum nasbt al-ithnayn bil mi2a min a3naf al-a3asyr li akthar min thlath sa3at.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Tasil sur3at hadhihi al3awasif al3anifa ila 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Yasna3u albashar al3adasat almukabira wa yastakhdimunaha mundhu alaf assinin.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Wa m3a dhalik, fa qad tama sun3 awal telescopat 7aqiqiya fi Europa fi awakhir alqarn assadis 3ashr.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Istakhdamat hadhihi altelescopat 3adastayn mudmajatayn kay taj3l al-ashya2 alba3ida tabdu aqrab wa akbara 7ajman.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Sayazalu aljasha3 wa al ananiya ma3ana da2iman, wa min tabi3at alta3awun annahu 3indama tastafid al aghlabiya sayakun hunaka da2iman almazid min almakasib 3ala almada alqasir min khilal attasaruf bi ananiya.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Na2mal 2an yudrika mu3zm annas anna afdal khiyar lahum 3ala almada attawil howa al3amal m3a al2akharin.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Ya7lum alkathir min annas bil yawm alladhy yumkinu fihi lil bashar assafar ila najmin akhar wa istikshaf 3awalim ukhra, wa yatsa2l alb3dh 7awla ma ya3tqiduh al-akharun ma idha kant alka2inat alfadha2iya aw al7ayat alukhra qad ta3ish 3la kawkab akhar 2am la.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Wa lakin, idha 7adatha hadha fi ayi waqt, fa min almu7tamal alla ya7duth li fatrat tawila jidan. annujum muntashira li darajat anna hunak trilyunat al amyal bayna annujum allaty tu3tabar "jiran".
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Rubbama sayqif a7fadik fi 3alm gharib wa ytsa2alun yawman ma 3an aslafihim alqudama?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Tatakawwan al7ayawanat min al3adid min alkhalaya. ya2kulun al ashya2 wa yahdimunaha fi ddakhil. yumkinu li mu3zam al7ayawanat atta7aruk.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Tamlik al7yawanat admigha faqt (3la arraghm min anna jami3 al7ayawanat la tamtalik admigha; fa inna qanadyl alba7r, 3ala sabil almithal, lysa ladyha admigha).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Tamma al3uthur 3ala al7ayawanat fi jami3 an7a2 al ard. ya7firun fil ardh wa yasba7un fil mu7itat wa yatirun fi ssama2.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Alkhaliya hiya asghar wi7da haykalia wa wazifiya lil ka2in al7ay (al-ashya2).
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Alkhaliya ta2ti min alkalima al-latiniya "cella" wa allati ta3ni alghurfa assaghira.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Idha nadharta ila alka2inat al7aya ta7ta almijhar, satara annaha masnu3a min muraba3at aw kurat saghira.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Laqad wajada 3alim ala7ya2 albritany Robert Hooke muraba3at saghira fil fillin bi istikhdam mijhar.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Tabdu ka ghuraf. kana awwalu shakhs yuraqib alkhalaya almayita.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Yumkin lil 3anasir wa almurakabat 2an tantaqila min 7ala ila ukhra wa la tataghayar.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Alnitrogen ghazun la yazalu lahu nafs khwas alnitrogen assa2il. Takunu al7ala assa2ila akthara kathaftan, wa lakinna aljuzay2at tadhal kama hiya duna taghyir.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Yu3addu alma2 mithalan akhar 3la dhalika. yatakawwanu alma2 almurakkab min dharatayn hydrogen wa dharart oxygen.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Lahu nafs attarkib aljuzay2i swa2 kana ghazan aw sa2ilan aw salban.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: 3ala arraghm min anna 7alatuhu alfizya2iya qad tataghayar, illa anna 7alatuhu alkimya2iya tadhalu nafsaha
