text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Azzaman shay2un yu7itu bina fi kulli makan, wa yu2athir 3ala kulli ma naqumu bihi, wa ma3a dhalika yas3ubu fahmuh.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Khadha3a mafhum azzaman li dirasa 3ala yad 3ulama2 addin, wal falsـafa li alaf assـinin.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Nushahidu azzaman ka silsila mina al-a7dath allaty tamurru mina almustaqbal, mururan bil 7adhir wa wusulan ila al-madhy.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Kama yushir azzaman ila kayfiyat muqaranatina li muddat (tul) al-a7dath.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Yumkinuka ta7did murur alwaqt bi nafsika min khilal muraqabat tikrar a7ad ala7dath addawriya. al7adath addwry huwa shay2un ya7duthu miraran wa tikraran bi shaklin muntazam.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Tustakhdamu ajhizat alcomputer alyawm li mu3alajat assuwar wa maqati3 al-video.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Yumkinu insha2 rusum muta7arikka mutatawwira 3ala ajhizt alcomputer wa yustakhdam hadha annaw3 mina arrusum almuta7arika bi shaklin mutazayid fi attelevision wal aflam.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Ghaliban ma tusajjal almusiqa bi istikhdam ajhizat 7asub mutatawira li mu3alajat al-aswat wa mazjiha ma3an.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Li fatra tawila khilal alqarnayn attasi3 3ashar wa al3ishrin, kana yu3taqad anna assukkan al awa2il li New Zelanda hum sha3b al Maori, alladhin istadu attuyur al3imlaqa almusamat moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Thumma assasat annazariya li fikrat 2anna sha3b al-Maori qad hajara min Polynesia fi ustulin 3azim, thumma akhz New Zelanda min Moriori wa assasa biha mujtama3an zira3iyan.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, tushir adilla jadida ila anna Moriori kanu majmu3a min almawiriyin min albar arra2isi alladhyn hajaru min New Zelanda ila juzur Chatham, li tatwir thaqafatihim almumayaza wa assilmiya.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kant hunaka aydhan qabila ukhra fi juzur Chatham, wa sukkanuha hum al-Maori alladhyna hajaru kharija New Zelanda.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Laqad atlaqu 3ala anfusihim ism al-Moriori, wa kant hunaka ba3dh almunawashat, wa fi annihaya tamma alqadha2 3alayhim.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Sa3adna al-afrad alladhina sharaku li 3iddat 3uqud fi taqdir niqat quwwatina wa shaghafina athna2 taqyim assu3ubat wa 7atta al-ikhfaqat.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Athna2 istma3ina ila al-afrad wa hum yusharikuna qisasahum wa qisas 3a2latihim wa mu2assasatihim, tashakkalat ladayna nadhra thaqiba 3an almadhy wa ta3arrafna 3ala b3dh ashakhsiyat allaty atharat bi shaklin jayid aw sayi2 3ala thaqaft almu2assasa.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Fi7in anna fahm tarikh ashakhs la ya3ny fahm thaqafatih, ila annahu yusa3idu al-ashkhas 3ala al-aqal 3ala iktisab al-i7sas bil makan alladhy kanu fih 3ala madar tarikh almu2assasa.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: 3inda taqyim alnaja7at wa idrak 7alat al-ikhfaq, yata3arrafu al-afrad wa jami3 al-ashkhas almusharikin 3ala alqiyam wa rrisala almaqsuda, wa alqiwa addafi3a lil munazama bi mazidin mina atta3amuq.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Fi hadhihi al7ala, sa3ada isti7dhar al-amthila assabiqa li suluk riyadat al-a3mal wa nnaja7at annatija 3an dhalik 3ammat annas 3ala al-infta7 3ala attaghriyarat aljadida w attawajuh aljadid lil kanisa alma7aliya.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Laqad qallalat qisas alnaja7 hadhihi min makhawif attaghyir, baynama khalaqat ittijahat ijabiya na7wa attaghyir fil mustaqbal.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Anmat attafkir almutaqariba hiya tiqaniya li 7al almushkilat tuwa7id al afkar aw almajalat almukhtalifa li ijad 7al.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Turakkizu hadhihi alqudra al3aqliya 3la assur3a, wa almantiq, wa addiqa, bil idhafa ila ta7did al7aqa2iq, wa i3adat tatbiq attiqaniyat al7aliya, wa jami3 alma3lumat.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Al-3amil al-aham fi hadha almafhum huwa annahu hnaka ijaba wa7id sa7i7a faqat. Anta tufakkiru fi ijabatayn faqat ima sa2iba aw khata2.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Yartabitu hadha annaw3 mina attafkir bi 3ilmin mu3ayn aw ijra2at mu3ayana.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Yamtaliku al-ashkhas alladhyna ladayhim hadha annaw3 mina attafkir mantiqiyan wa qadiran 3ala 7ifz al-anmat wa 7al almushkilat wa al3amal 3ala al-ikhtibarat al3ilmiya.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Yu3tabar albashar ila 7adin ba3id akthar al anwa3 mawhibatan fi qira2at 3uqul al2akharin.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Wa hadha ya3ny annana qadirun 3ala attanabbu2 bi naja7 bima yudrikuhu albashar al-akharun aw yuqaddimunahu aw yu2minun bihi aw ya3rifunahu aw yarghabun fih.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Min bayni hadhihi alqudrat, fahm niyat al2akharin 2amrun baligh al ahammiya. yasma7u lana bi 7al alghumud almu7taml fil af3al aljasadiya.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: 3ala sabil almithal, idha ra2ayta shakhsan yaksir nafidhat sayara, fa mina almu7tamal 2an taftaridha annahu kana yu7awil sariqat sayarat shakhs gharib.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Sayakunu bi 7aja ila al7ukm 3alayhi bi shaklin mukhtalif idha faqada mafati7 sayaratih wa kanat sayaratuhu hiya allaty yu7awil iqti7amaha.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: Ya3tamidu attaswir bi arranin almaghnatisy 3ala dhahart fizya2iya tusamma arranin almaghnatisy alnawawy (NMR), wa allaty iktshafaha Felix Bloch (wa allathy ya3mal fi jami3at Stanford) wa Edward Purcell (min jami3at Harvard) f athalathiniya.
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Fi hadha arranin, yatasabbab almajal almighnatisy wa mawjat arradio fi itlaq adharrat li isharat radio daqiqa.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Fi 3am 1970, iktishaf attabib wa 3alm al-ab7ath Raymond Damadian asas istikhdam attaswyr bil ranyn almaghnatisi bi i3tibariha addat lil tashkhis attibi.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Ba3da arba3 sanawat tamma man7 bara2at ikhtira3, wa allaty kanat awal bara2at ikhtira3 fi al3alam yatimmu isdaruha fi majal attaswir bi arranin almighnatisi.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Fi 3am 1977, intaha aldoctor Damadian insha2 awal jihaz taswir bil arranin almighnatisi "lil jism ba akmalih", wa allathy 2utliqa 3alayhi "aljihaz allathy la yuqhar".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Yushajji3 al itisal ghayr almutazamin 3ala alwaqt li ttafkir wa attafa3ul m3a al2akharin.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Yuti7 li ttullab alqudra 3la al3amal wifqan li darajat taqaddumihim wa tta7akkum fi watirat alma3lumat atta3limiya.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Bil idhafa ila dhalika, hunaka alqalil min alquyud azzamaniya ma3a imkaniyat sa3at 3amal marina. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Yuti7u istikhdam al-internet wa shabakat alweb al3alamiya lil muta3allimin alwusul ila alma3lumat fi kul al-awqat.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Yumkinu li ttullab aydhan irsal as2ila ila al-mudarrisin fi ayi waqt khilala alyawm wa tawaqqu3 ijaba sari3a bi shaklin ma3qul badlan min al-intizar 7atta al-ijtima3 attaly wajhan li wajh.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Tatadhmman manhajiyat ma b3da al-7adatha fi ta3allum fikrat atta7arrur min almutlaqat. la tujadu tariqa jayida wa7ida li tta3allum.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Fi 7aqiqat al-2amr, la yujadu shay2 wa7id jayid yumkinu ta3allumuh. Ta7duth 3amaliyat atta3allum fil tajriba bayna almuta3allim wal ma3rifa al-muqaddama.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Tuwadhi7u tajribatana al-7alya fi muhimat "isna3ha bi nafsik" wa taqdim alma3lumat wal baramij alttilifizyuniya alqa2ima 3ala 3amaliyat atta3allum hadhihi annuqta.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Yajid alkathir minna nafsahu yushahid 3ardan tilifizyuniyan yukhbiruna bi 3amaliya aw tajriba lan nusharika fiha aw nutabiqa tilka alma3rifa abadan.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Lan naquma mutlaqan bi isla7 sـayara, aw bina2 nafura fil fina2 alkhalfy, aw assafar ila Peru li fa7s al-2athar al-qadima aw i3adat tasmim manzil jarina.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Bi fadhl rwabit kablat al-alyaf adhaw2iya al-maghmura bi Europa wal aqmar assina3iya dhat annitaq al3aridh, fa inna Greenland muttasila jayidan bi nisbat 93% min assukkan alladhina ladayhim itisal bil internet.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Sayatawaffar 3ala al-arja7 fi funduqik aw lada mudhifika (idha kunta tuqim fi dar dhiyafa aw manzil khas) shabakt Wi-Fi aw computer muttasil bil internet, kama 2anna jami3 amakin al-iqama biha maqha internet aw mwqi3 bihi shabakat Wi-Fi 3amma.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Kama dhukira a3lah, 3la arraghm min anna kalimat "Eskimo" tadhallu maqbula fi alwilayat al-mutta7ida, illa annaha tu3tabar izdira2an min qibal al-3adid min shu3ub alqutb ashamali ghayr al amrikiya, wa khassatan fi Canada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Fi 7in annaka qad tasma3 al-kalimat allaty yastakhdimuha sukkan Greenland al-asliyin, yajib 3ala al-ajanib tajannub isـtikhdamiha.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Yutliq assukkan al-asliyun fi Greenland 3ala anfusihim ism al-Inuit fi Canada, wa Kalaalleq (jam3 Kalaallit), ay Greenlander, 3ala man ya3ishuna fi Greenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: Al-jarima wa su2 anniya tijah al-ajanib bi-shaklin 3am ghayr ma3rufin taqriban fi Greenland. 7atta fil mudun, la tujad "manatiq wa3ira".
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Rubbama yakunu attaqs al-bared howa al-khatar al-7aqiqi al-wa7id alladhy sayuwajihuh ghayr al-musta3idin.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Idha qumta bi ziyarat Greenland khilal al-mawasim al-barida (m3a al-akhdh fil i3tibar annahu kullama itajahta shamalan, sayakunu al-jaw akthar buruda), fa min addarury i7dar malabis dafi2a kafiya.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Qad yatasabbab tul al-yawm fi fasl assayf fi 7uduth mushkila tata3allaq bil-7usul 3ala qistin kafin mina annawm wa ma yusa7ib dhalika min mushkilat si7iya.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Khilal assayf, i7taris aydhan mina al-ba3udh ashamal europy. 3ala arraghm min annahu la yanqul ay amradh, illa 2annahu qad yakunu muz3ijan.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Baynama yartabitu iqtisad San Francisco bi-kawniha mantiqa 3alamiya li-jadhb assuya7, ya3tamidu iqtisaduha 3ala masadir mutanawi3a.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Alkhadamat almihaniya wal 7ukumiya wal maliya wa ttijara wa ssiya7a hiya akbar qita3at attawdhif.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Laqad sa3ada taswiruha al-mutakarrir fil musiqa wal aflam wal 2adab wal thaqafa asha3biya fi ja3l al-madina wa ma3alimiha ma3rufa fi jami3 an7a2 al-3alam.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: Laqad tawwarat San Francisco binya ta7tiya siya7iya kabira bil idhafa ila al-3adid min al-fanadiq wal mata3im wa marafiq al-mu2tamarat min addaraja al-2ula.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: Tu3addu San Francisco aydhan a7ad afdhal al-amakin fil balad bi nnisba lil ma2kulat al-asyawiya al-2ukhra: al-kuriya wal taylandiya wal hindiya wal yabaniya.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Yushakkil assaـfar ila 3alam Walt Disney ri7latan ra2isiya yaqsiduha al-3adid min al-3a2ilat al-amrikiya.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Tatadhaman azziyara "al-mu3tada" assafar ila matar Orlando addawly, thumma al-2intiqal bil 7afila ila a7ad fanadiq Disney fil mawqi3, wa qadha2 7awaly 2usbu3 duna mughadarat munsha2at Disney, wa ba3da dhalika ya2ty maw3id al-3awda ila al-watan.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Tujad ikhtilafat la niha2iya qad ta7duth, wa lakin la yazalu hadha al-2amr alladhy ya3nihi aghlab al-ashkhas 3indama yata7addathun 3an "adhahab ila 3alam Disney".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Yatimmu istikhdam al-3adid min attadhakir allaty yatimmu bay3uha 3abra al-internet min khilal mawaqi3 al-mazadat mithl eBay aw Craigslist juz2iyan ka tadhakir Park-hopper muta3addidat al-ayam.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Fi 7yn annahu yu3addu nashatan sha2i3an lil ghaya, illa anna Disney tu7adhiru minhr: fa-attazakir ghayr qabila lil intiqal ila ghayrik.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Yatatallab ay mu3askar 3ala 7afat nahr Grand Canyon al-7usul 3ala tasri7 min adha7iya.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Taqtasir attsari7 3ala 7imayat al-wady, wa takunu muta7a fil yawm al-awwal min ashahr, arba3at ashhur qabla shahr al-bidaya.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Li-hadha, yusbi7 tasri7 arrif li-ayi tarikh bad2an min Mayo muta7an fi 1 Yanayer.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Tumla2 misa7at al-manatiq al-akthar sha3biyatan, mithl Bright Angel Campground al-mujawira li-Phantom Ranch, 3umuman bi-ttalabat al-warida fi attarikh al-2awwal, 7aythu yatimmu fat7uha lil 7ujuzat.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Yujad 3adad ma7dud min attasari7 al-ma7juza li-talabat al-7udhur al-mutawaffira 3ala asـas asـbaqiyat al-7udhur.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Yu3addu addukhul ila janub ifriqya bi-ssayara tariqatan ra2i3a li mushahadat jamal al-mintaqa bil kamil wa kadhalika lil wusul ila amakin ba3ida 3an atturuq assiya7iya al-3adiya.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Yumkinu al-qiyam bi-hadha al-2amr fi sayara 3adiya min khilal attakhtit lahu bi-3inaya, wa lakin yunsa7u bi-shidda istikhdam sayara daf3 ruba3y, wala yumkinu alwusul ila al-3adid min al-mawaqi3 illa min khilal qa3idat 3ajalat 3aliya addaf3 4x4.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Yajib 2an tadha3a fi i3tibarika athna2 attakhtit annahu 3ala arraghm min istiqrar janub ifriqya, illa 2anna jami3 al-buldan al-mujawira laysat kadhalik.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Takhtalif mutatallabat atta2shira wa takalifiha min dawla ila 2ukhra, wa tata2athar hadhihi ashurut bil balad alladhy 2atayta minh.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Yatadhaman kullu balad aydhan qawanin farida tatlub ma ta7tajuhu min mustalzamat attawari2 li takuna fi assayara.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Tumathil shallalat Victoria madina taqa3 fil juz2 al-gharby min Zimbabwe, 3abra al-7udud al-mumtadda min Livingstone fi Zambia, wa hiya taqa3u bil qurb min Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Taqa3u al-madina bi-janib ashallalat mubasharatan, wa hiya nuqta ra2isiـya lil jadhb assiya7y, illa 2anna hadhihi al-wijha assiـya7iya ashahira tuwaffiru li kul min al-ba7ithin 3an al-mughamara wal mutanazzihin furasan kathira lil iqama li mudda atwal.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Fi mawsim hutul al-amtar (ibtida2an min Novemer ila Mars), sayartafi3u mansub 7ajm al-ma2 wa satakunu ashallalat akthar 7idda wa ashadda 3unfan.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Nu2akkidu annaka satata3arradh lil balal idha 3abarta al-jisr aw sirta 3abra al-mamarrat al-muta3arrija bil qurb min ashallalat.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Wa min na7iya 2ukhra, wa nadharan li-irtifa3 7ajm al-ma2, 3ala wajh atta7did, fa-2inna ru2yatak li shallalat al-fi3liya satakunu ma7jubatan bil miyah!
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Maqbarat Tutankhamun (KV62). qad takunu maqbarat Tutankhamun (KV62) ashhar al-maqabir fil wady, mashhad yudhhir iktishaf Howard Carter 3am 1922 al-maqbara malakiya shibh sـalima lil malik ashab.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Bil muqarana ma3a mu3dham al-maqabir al-malakiya al-2ukhra, fa-2inna qabr Tutankhamun bil kad yasta7iqu azziyara, li kawnihi asghar bi-kathir wa dhu zakharif qalila.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Ayu shakhs muhtam bi-ru2yat dalil 3ala al-adhrar allaty la7iqat bil-mumya2 athna2 mu7awalat izalatiha min attabut sayusab bi-khaybat 2amal li-2anna arra2s wal katifayn faqat huma aladhayn yumkinu ru2yatuha.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Lam ta3ud almaqabir ta7wy atharawat al-muzhila, bal nuqilat ila al-mat7af al-masry bil-qahira.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Mina al-afdhal 2an yaqdi azzuwar dhawu al-waqt al-ma7dud waqtahum fi makanin 2akhar.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, yab3udu 12 km janub gharb madinat Siem Reap. buniya hadha al-ma3bad 3ala qimmat tal fi nihayat al-qarn attasi3, fi 3ahd al-malik Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Al-ajwa2 al-mudhlima lil-ma3bad, wa itlalatuhu 3ala bu7ayrat Tonle Sap taj3al attasalluq ila attal jadiran bil-ihtimam.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Yumkinu aljam3 bayna ziyarat al-mawqi3 wa ri7la bil-qarib ila al-bu7ayra.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Yalzam wujud mamar Angkor li dukhul al-ma3bad, li-dhalika la tansa i7dhar jawaz safarik 3inda attawajuh ila Tonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Al-qusd hiya 3asimat falastin al-mu7talla wa akbar muduniha, 3ala arraghm min 2anna mu3dham adduwal al-2ukhra wal 2umam al-mutta7ida la ta3tarifu biha ka-3asima li-isra2yl.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Tatamatta3 al-madina al-qadima fi tilal yahuda bi-tarikh 3ariq yamtaddu li-2alaf assinin.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Hiya madina muqaddasa lil-adyan assaـmawiya athalath - al-yahudiya wal masi7iya wal islam, wa hiya bi-mathabat markaz raw7any wa diny, wa thaqafy.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Nadharan lil-ahamiya addiniya lil-madina, wa la siyama al-mawaqi3 al-3adida fi mintaqat al-balda al-qadima, tu3addu al-quds wa7ida min al-wijhat assiya7iya arra2isiya fi isra2il.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yujad fil quds al-3adid min al-mawaqi3 attarikhiya wal athariya wa thaqafiya, bil-idhafa ila marakiz attasawwuq wal maqahy wal mata3im al-7ayawiya wal muzda7ima.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Tashtarit al Ecuador 2an yatalaqqa al-muwatinun al-Cubiyun khitab da3wa qabla dukhul aradiha 3abra al-matarat adduwaliya aw niqat addukhul al-7ududiya.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Yajib al-musadaqa 3ala hadha al-khitab min qibal wizarat al-kharijiya al-ecuadoriya, kama yajib 2an yatwafaqa ma3a mutatallabat mu3ayna.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Wudhi3at hadhihi ashurut li-taqdim turuq munadhamma li-tadaffuq al-muhajirin bayna al-baladayn.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Yajib 3ala al-muwatinin al-cubiyin min 7amili al-bitaqa al-khadra2 al-amrikiya ziyarat al-qunsuliya al-ecuadoriya lil 7usul 3ala i3fa2 min hadha ashart.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Yajib 2an yakuna jawaz safarik sariyan li--muddat 6 ashhur 3ala al-aqal ba3da tarikh safarik. yajib 2an yakuna ladayka tadhkarat dhahab wa 3awda li-ithbat tul muddat 2iqamatik.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Takunu as3ar al-jawlat arkhas lil-majmu3at al-kubra, lidha idha kunta bi-mufradik aw ma3a sadiq wa7id faqat, fa 7awil muqabalat ashkhas akharin wa takwin majmu3at min arba3 ila sittat ashkhas lil-7usul 3ala si3r afdhal lil-fard.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Wa ma3a dhalik, la yanbaghy 2an yakuna hadha 7aqqan min dawa3i qalaqik, 7aythu ghaliban ma yatimmu jar assuya7 li mal2 assayarat.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Yabdu fi waqi3 al-2amr bi-2annaha tariqa li-khida3 annas lil-i3tiqad bi-2annahu yajibu 3alayhim daf3 al-mazid.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Li-hadha al-jabal shadid al-in7idar irtifa3 shahiq fawqa attaraf ashamaly min Machu Picchu, wa yushakkilu ghaliban khalfiyatan lil-3adid min suwar al-2athar.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Yabdu al-2amru shaqqan ba3dha ashay2 mina al-asfal, wa huwa su3udun shadid al-in7idar wa sa3b, lakinna mu3dham al-ashkhas alladhina yatamatta3un bi-liyaqa badaniya 3aliya yajib 2an yakunu qadirin 3ala attasalluq wal wusul ilayh fi 7awaly 45 daqiqa.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Tudha3u assalalim al-7ajariya 3ala tul al-masar, wa tuwaffiru al-kablat al-fulaziya fil ajza2 al-akthar in7idaran darabzin da3im.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, tawaqqa3 2alla tastati3a 2iltiqata anfasik, wa tawakhi al-7adhr fi al-ajza2 al-akthar in7idaran, khasstan 3indama takunu muballala, 7aythu yumkinu 2an tusbi7a khatiratan bi-sur3a.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Yaqa3u kahfun saghir bil-qurb min al-qimma wa yanbaghy al-murur 3abrahu, fa huwa munkhafidh lil-ghaya wa dhayiq ba3dha ashay2.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Mina al-afdhql mushahadat al-amakin wal 7ayat al-barriya fi juzur  Galapagos bil-qarib, tmaman kama fa3ala Charles Darwin 3am 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Akthar min 60 safina siya7iya tajubu juzur Galapagos – 7aythu tata7ammal assafina min 8 ila 100 rakib.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Ya7jiz mu3dham annas makanahum fi waqtin mubakkir (li-2anna al-qawarib 3adatan ma takunu mumtali2a khilal mawsim adhurwa).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Ta2akkad min 2anna al-wakil alladhy ta7jiz min khilalih mutakhassis fi juzur Galapagos wa ladayhi ma3rifa jayida bi majmu3a mutanawi3a mina assufun.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Sayadhmanu dhalika twafuq ihtimamatikum wa/aw al-7udud allaty tadha3uha ma3a assafina al-akthar mula2ama bi-nnisbati lahum.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Qabla wusul al-espan fil qarn assadis 3ashar, kana shamal Chile ta7ta 7ukm al-Inca, baynama kana sukkan al Araucaniun al-asliyun (Mapuche) yuskunun wasat wa janub Chile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Kanat al-Mapuche aydhan wa7ida min akhir majmu3at assukan al-asliyin al-mustaqilin bi-amrika, wa allaty lam takhdha3 bil-kamil li-7ukm annatiqin bil-espaniya 7atta istiqlal Chile.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: 3ala arraghm min i3lan Chile istiqlaliha fi 3am 1810 (wasat 7urub Napoleon allaty tarakat Espanya bidun 7ukuma markazyia 3amila li muddat 3amayn), illa 2anna annasr al-7asim 3ala al-espan lam yata7aqqaq 7atta 3am 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Jumhuriyat ad-Dominican (bil-espaniya: República Dominicana) hiya dawla karibiya tasghal annisf asharqi min jazirat Hispaniola, wa allaty tatashـaraku fiha ma3a Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Ila janib ashawati2 dhat arrimal al-bayda2 wal manadhir attabi3iya al-jabaliya, tu3addu al-bilad mawtinan li-aqdam madina europiya fil amrikiyatayn, wa hiya al-2an juz2 min Santo Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Kana yaqtunu al-jazira fi bidayat al-2amr qabilat Taínos and al-caribiyin. wa qad kana al-caribiyun min al-ashkhas annatiqin bi-lughat al-arawakan alladhyna wasalu ila hunak 3am 10000 qabla al-milad taqriban.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Fi ghudun bidh3 sـanawat ba3da wusul al-mustakshifin al-europiyin, 2inkhafadha 3adad sukkan Tainos bi-shaklin kabir min qibal al-ghuzat al-espan
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Istinadan ila Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias), fa qad qatala al-ghuzat al-espan 7awaly 100,000 min al Tainos bayna 3amay 1492 wa 1498.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. tamma bina2 hadhihi al-misa7a ka-atrium li-dayr mina al-qarn assabi3 3ashar, wa alladhi yu3tabar Templo de San Diego al-mabna al-wa7id al-baqi minhu.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ta3malu al-2an ka-sa7a markaziyya, wa ladayha da2iman al-kathir mina al-2umur al lati t7duth laylan wa naharan.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Hunaka 3adad min al-mata3im al-mu7ita bil-7adiqa, wa khilal fatrat ma b3d adhahira wa fil masa2 ghaliban ma tuqamu 7afalat musiqiya majjaniya min al-maqsura al-markaziya lil-7adiqa.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Mamsha alqubla) shurfatan tafsil baynahuma 69 cm faqat hiya mawtin 2usturat 7ob qadima.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Saya7ky laka b3dh al-atfal al-qissa muqabil qurush qalila.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Jazirat Bowen hiya ri7la nahariya shahira aw ri7lat 3utlat nihayat al-2usbu3 tuqaddim attajdif bil-kayak wal-mashy li-masafat tawila wal matajir wal mata3im wa akthar min dhalik.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Yaqa3u hadha al-mujtama3 al-asil fi Howe Sound qubalat Vancouver, wa yumkinu al-wusul ilayh bi-suhula 3abra sayarat al-2ujra al-ma2iya al-mujadwala allaty tughadir jazirat Granville fi wasat madinat Vancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Bi-nnisba li-2ula2ika alladhyn yastamti3una bil-anshita al-kharijiya, fa 2inna al-qiyam bi-ri7la 3abra mamar Sea to Sky 2amrun dharury.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Tu3addu takalif ziyarat madinat Whistler (3ala bu3d sـa3a wa nisf bi-ssayara min Vancouver) bahidha, wa lakinnaha mashhura bi-sabab 2iqamat butulat al-al3ab al-Olimpiya ashitwiya li-3am 2010 biha.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Fi shita2, yumkinuka al-istimta3 bi-ba3dh min afdhal makan li-ttazalluj fi amrika ashamaliya, wa fi ssayf yumkinuka tajribat rukub addarajat al-jabaliya al-asila.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Yajib 7ajz attasari7 musbaqan. yajib 2an yakuna ladayka tasri7 lil-mabit fi funduq Sirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Tu3addu Sirena m7attat al7irasa al-wa7ida allaty tuqaddimu assakan fi salat nawm mushtaraka wa wajabat sakhina bil-2idhafa ila attakhyim. la tuqaddimu qura La Leona wa San Pedrillo wa Los Patos siwa attakhyim bidun khidmat ta3am.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Mina al-mumkin al-7usul 3ala tasari7 al-7adiqa mubasharatan min markaz al-7irasa fi muqata3at Puerto Jiménez, lakinnahum la yaqbalun bitaqat al-i2timan
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: La tusdiru khidmat al-muntazah (MINAE) tasari7 intidhar qabla akthar min shahr wa7id mina al-wusul al-murtaqab.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: Tuqaddimu CafeNet El Sol khidmat 7ajz muqabil rusum qadruha 30 dolar amriki, aw 10 dolarat amrikiya li yawmin wa7id; attafasil 3ala saf7at Corcovado al-khassa bihim.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Juzur Cook hiya dawla tatakawwan min 3iddat juzur laha irtibat 7ur ma3a New Zelanda, wa taqa3u fi Polynesia bi-wasat janub al-mu7it al-hadi2.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Innahu arkhabil yadhum 15 jazira tnatashir 3ala misa7at tazidu 3an 2.2 milyun kilometr murabba3 min al-mu7it.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Li-tamayuziha bi-nnitaq azzamany nafsahu li-Hawaii, yundhar a7yanan ila al-juzur 3ala annaha "al-mantiqa al-3aliya min Hawaii".
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: 3ala arraghm min kawniha asghar 7ajman, fa hiya tudhakkir ba3dh kibar assin azza2irin laha bi-Hawaii qabla istiqlaliha, wa kayfa kanat duna kul al-fanadiq assiya7iya al-kabira wa ghayriha mina attatawwurat.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: La tadhumu juzur Cook ay mudun, wa lakinnaha tadhum 15 jazira mukhtalifa. ahammuha jazirat Rarotonga wa Aitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Fil buldan al-mutaqadima alyawm, jara al-irtiqa2 bi-mustawa tawfir amakin al-mabit al-fakhira wa wajabat al-iftar ila shaklin min ashkal al-fan.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Fi annihaya, mina al-wadi7 2anna amakin al-mabit wal iftar tatanafas bi-shakl asasy 3ala shay2ayn ra2isiyan: al-firash wa wajabat al-iftar.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Wifqan li dhalika, fi afdhal hadhihi al-mu2assasat, yumkinu lil-mar2 2an yajida afkham anwa3 al-afrisha, rubbama li7af masnu3 yadawiyan aw sarir 3atiq.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Qad yashmal al-iftar al-ma2kulat al-mawsimiya lil mintaqa aw tabaq al-balad almudhif al-khas.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Qad yakunu al-mawqi3 mabnan tarikhy qadim yatamayaz bi-wujud athath 3atiq, wa misa7at khadhra2 mushadhabba, wa 7awdh siba7a.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Rukub sayaratik al-khassa wal intilaq fi ri7la barriya tawila lahu jadhibiya fi3liya fi basatatih.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: 3ala 3aks assayarat al-akbar 7ajman, qad takunu mu3tadan bil-fi3l 3ala qiyadat sayaratik wa 3ala 3ilm bi-imkaniyatiha.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Yumkinu 2an yu2ady insha2 khayma fi milkiya khassa aw fi madina min ayi 7ajm ila jadhb al-intibah ghayr al-marghub fihi bi-suhula.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Khulasat al-qawl, yu3addu istikhdam sayaratik tariqa ra2i3a lil-qiyam bi-ra7alat barriya, wa lakinnahu nadiran ma takunu wasilat li-iqamat "mukhayam".
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Yumkinu attakhyim fi assayara idha kana ladayk minivan kabir aw sayarat daf3 ruba3y aw sedan aw Station Wagon bi-maqa3id ta2khudh wadh3 al-istilqa2.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Tatamatta3 ba3dh al-fanadiq bi-turath min al-3asr adhahaby li-ssikak al-7adidiya al-bukhariya wa khat al-mu7itat; qabla al-7arb al-3alamiya athaniya, fil qarn attasi3 3ashar aw awa2il al-qarn al-3ishrin.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Shakkalat hadhihi al-fanadiq al-makan allathy qad yuqimu fih al-mashahir, wa ghaliban ma kanat tuqaddimu ta3aman shahiyan wa saharat ra2i3a.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Tu3addu al-mustalzamat dhat attiraz al-qadim, wa nuqs a7dath wasa2il attarfih, wa attasarruf bi-tariqa ma tula2im attaqaddum fil 3umr aydhan juz2an min shakhsiyatihim.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Fi 7in 2annaha 3adatan ma ta2ul ila milkiya khassa, illa 2annaha tastaw3ibu a7yanan ru2asa2 adduwal azza2irin wa ghayrihim mina ashakhsiyat al-marmuqa.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Qad yufakkiru al-musafir alladhy yamlik amwal ta2ila fi ri7lat tayaran 7awla al-3alam, wa tuqati3uh al-iqamat fil 3adid min hadhihi al-fanadiq.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Shabakat tabadul adhiyafa hiya almunadhama allaty tarbit al-musafirin bi-ssukkan al-ma7aliyin fil mudun allaty sayazurunaha.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: 3adatan ma yatatallab al-indhimam ila hadhih ashabakat mal2 namudhaj 3abra al-internet; bi-rraghm min 2anna ba3dh ashabakat tuqaddim aw tatatallab ta7qiqan idhafiyan.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Thumma yatimmu taqdim qa2ima bil-mudhifin al-muta7in 2imma matbu3a wa/aw 3abra al-internet, a7yanan ma3a al-muraji3 wal ta3liqat min qibal al-musafirin al-akharin.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Ta2assasa mawqi3 Couchsurfing fi yanayir 2004 ba3da 2an wajada mubarmij al-computer Casey Fenton ri7latan rakhisa ila Icelanda wa lakin lam yakun ladayh makan lil-iqama.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Qama bi-irsal barid electrony ila attullab fil jami3a al-ma7aliya wa talaqqa 3adadan ha2ilan mina al-3urudh lil-7usul 3ala sakan majanny.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Tullabi buyut ashabab i7tiyajat ashabab fil maqam al-awwal - fa-ddayf annamudhaji howa dhalika alladhy yakunu fil 3ishrinat mina al3umr - wa lakin ghaliban ma tajid musafirin akbar sinnan hunak aydhan.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Tu3tabar al-3a2ilat allaty ladayha atfal mashhadan nadiran, lakin b3dh buyut ashabab taqbaluhum fil ghuraf al-khassa.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Satakunu madinat Pekin fi ssin al-madina al-mudhifa lil-al3ab al-Olimpiya ashitwiya fi 3am 2022, mimma yaj3aluha awwal madina tastadhif kullan mina al-al3ab al-Olimpiya assayfiya wa ashitwiya.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Satastadhif Beijing 7aflatay al-iftita7 wal khitam wa tadhahurat al-jalid addakhiliya.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Satuqam fa3aliyat tazalluj 2ukhra fi mantiqat Taizicheng li-ttazalluj fi madinat Zhangjiakou, 3ala bu3d 7awaly 220 kilometr (140 mile) min Bekin.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Mu3dham al-ma3abid ladayha 3id sanawy yabda2 min nihayat November wa 7atta muntasaf Mayo, wa alladhy yakhtalifu wifqan li-ttaqwim assanawy li-kulli ma3bad.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Yajry al-i7tifal bi-mu3dham al-a3yad fil ma3bad ka-juz2 min dhikra al-ma3bad aw 3id milad al-2ilah aw ayi 7adath kabir akhar murtabit bil-ma3bad.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Tu3addu mahrajanat al-ma3abid fi wilayat Kerala mumti3a lil-ghaya, bil-idhafa ila mawkib muntadham lil-afyal al-muzakhrafa w orchestra al-ma3bad wa ghyriha mina al-i7tifalat.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Al-ma3radh al-3alamy (al-ma3ruf bi-ism al-ma3radh al-3alamy, aw bi-basata al-ma3radh) huwa mahrajan dawly kabir lil funun wal 3ulum.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Tuqaddimu adduwal al-musharika 3urudhan fanniya wa ta3limiya fil ajni7a alwataniya li-3ardh qadaya al-3alam aw thaqafat wa tarikh biladihim.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Ma3aridh zira3at al-basatin addawliya hiya fa3aliya mutakhassisa tusallit adhaw2 3ala 3urudh al-azhar wal 7ada2iq annabatiya wa ayu shay2in akhar yata3allaq bi-nnabatat.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: 3ala arraghm min 2annaha yumkinu 2an ta7dutha mina anna7iya annadhariya sanawiyan (talama 2annaha mawjuda fi buldan mukhtalifa), illa 2annaha 3amaliyan laysat kadhalik.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Tasـtamirru hadhihi al-fa3aliyat 3adatan ma bayna thalath wa sittat ashhur, wa tuqamu fi mawaqi3 la taqillu misa7atuha 3an 50 hiktar.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Yujad al-3adid min siyagh al-aflam al-mukhtalifa allaty 2ustukhdimat 3ala mar assinin. yablugh 7ajm ashari7a al-qiyasy 35 mm (36 × 24 mm) wa huwa al-akthar shuyu3an.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: 3adatan ma yumkin tajdiduha bi-shaklin daqiq wa bi-suhula idha tawaqqafat, wa tu3ty diqqa mumathila taqriban li-camera DSLR al-7aliya.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Tastakhdimu ba3dh camerat al-aflam mutawassitat al-7ajm sighat 6×6 cm, wa bi-sura adaq salib 56 × 56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Hadha al-2amr yu3ty diqqa arba3 marrat akthar tablugh 35 mm (3136 mm2 muqabil 864).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Tu3addu al-7ayah al-barriya min bayni akthar al-mawdu3at ta7ddiyan bi-nnisba lil-musawwir al-fotoghrafy, wa yajib 2an yajtami3a ladayhi 7usnu al-7adh, ma3a atta7ally bi-ssabr, wa imtilak al-khibra, wa attazawwud bil-mu3iddat al-jayida.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Yu3addu taswir al-7ayat al-barriya ghaliban 2amran badihiyan, wa lakin mithl attaswir al-fotografy bi-shaklin 3am, tajidu assuwar tu3abbir 3an alf kalima.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Ytatallab taswir al-7ayah al-barriya 3adasa tawila fil aghlab, wa dhalika 3ala arraghm min 2anna ashya2 mithl sirb min attuyur aw makhluq saghir ya7taj ila 3adasat 2ukhra.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Yas3ub al-3uthur 3ala al-3adid min al-7aywanat al-ghariba, wa a7yanan tadha3u al-muntazahat qawa3id bi-sha2n iltiqat assuwar li-aghradh tijariya.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Qad takun al-7ayawanat al-barriya 2imma khajula wa 2imma 3udwaniya. Qad takun al-bi2a barida, aw 7arra, aw ghayr mula2ima bi-ayi shakl 2akhar.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Hunaka akthar min 5000 lugha mukhtalifa 7awla al-3alam, akthar min 3ishrin lugha minha yata7addathuha 50 milyun shakhs aw akthar.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Yashul fil aghlab aydhan fahm al-kalimat al-maktuba 3an al-kalimat al-mantuqa. yantabiqu hadha al-2amr bi-shaklin khas 3ala al-3anawin, wa allaty ghaliban ma yas3ub nutquha bi-wudhu7.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Tata7addath al-3adid min adduwal bi-akmaliha al-ingliziya bi-talaqa, wa 7atta akthar min dhalik yumkinuka 2an tatawaqqa3 ma3rifa ma7duda - khassatan bayna ashabab.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Takhayal, idha sa7a atta3bir, rajul Mancuni, wa Bustunani, wa Jamayki, wa Sydneysider jalisun 7awla tawila yatanawalun al-3asha2 fi mat3am fi Toronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Yastamti3un ma3an bi-sard qisas min mwatinihim, turwa bi lahjatihim al-mutamayiza  wa 3ibaratihim al-3amiya al-ma7aliya.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: 3adatan ma yakunu shira2 atta3am min ma7allat al-super market arkhas wasila lil-7usul 3ala atta3am. Li-3adam wujud furas li-ttahy, fa 2inna al-khiyarat taqtasir 3ala atta3am al-jahiz.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ta7sul al-matajir al-kubra bi-shaklin mutazayid 3ala qism akthar tanawwu3an min atta3am al-jahiz. wa dhahaba al-ba3dh ila tawfir furn microwave aw wasila 2ukhra li-taskhin atta3am.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Fi ba3dh al-buldan aw anwa3 al-matajir, yujad mat3am wa7id 3ala al-aqal dakhil al-munsha2a, wa ghaliban ma yakunu mat3aman ghayr rasmy ila 7addin ma wa bi-as3ar ma3qula.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: 2a3id nuskha min awraqik wa ma3lumat al-ittisal bi-sharikat atta2min al-khassa bik wa i7milha ma3ak.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Hum bi-7aja ila idhhar 3unwan al-barid al-electrony li-sharikat atta2min, wa arqam al-hawatif adduwaliya lil-7usul 3ala al-mashura/attafwidhat wa taqdim ashakawa.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: I7tafidh bi-nuskha 2ukhra fi amti3atik wa 3abra al-internet (arsil li-nafsik baridan electroniyan bi-murfaqat aw qum bi-takhzinih fi "assa7aba").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Idha kunta tusafir ma3a jihaz computer ma7mul aw jihaz law7y, fa qum bi-takhzin nuskha fi dhakiratih aw qursih (yumkinu al-wusul ilayha bidun internet).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Qaddim aydhan nuskhantan min assiyasat/jihat al-itisal li-rifaq assafar wa al-aqarib aw al-asdiqa2 3ala isti3dad lil-musa3ada.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Al-ghazal al-amriki (alladhy yu3raf aydhan bi-ism adhaby) laysa 3udwaniyan bi-tabi3atih wa lakinnahu sayudafi3u 3an nafsih idha istash3ara wujud khatar yuhaddiduh.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: 3indama la yara al-ashkhas 2anna al-ghazal al-Amriki adhakhm la yushakkilu khataran mu7tamalan, fa qad yaqtaribuna kathiran minhu wa yu3arridhu anfusahum lil-khatar..
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Ishrab al-mashrubat al-ku7uliya bi-i3tidal. yu2athiru al-ku7ul 3ala kulli shakhs bi-shaklin mukhtalif, wa ma3rifat 7ududik 2amrun muhim lil-ghaya.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Yumkinu 2an tashmal al-a7dath assi7ya al-mu7tamala 3ala al-mada al-ba3id min al-ifrat fi shurb al-ku7ul talaf al-kadib wa 7atta fuqdan al-basar wal wafat. yazdadu al-khatar al-mu7tamal 3inda istihlak al-ku7uliyat al-muntajat bi-shaklin ghyr qanuny.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Yumkin 2an ta7tawy al-mashrubat arru7iya ghayr ashar3iya 3ala shawa2ib khatira mukhtalifa bima fi dhalika al-methanol, wa alladhy yumkin 2an yusabbiba al-3ama aw al-mawt 7atta fil jur3at assaghira.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Yumkinu 2an takuna annadharat arkhas fi balad ajnabi, khassatan fil al-buldan munkhafidha addakhl 7aythu takunu takalif al-3amala aqal.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Da3 fi i3tibarik ijra2 fa7s lil-3ayn fil manzil, khassatan idha kana atta2min yughatih, wa a7dhir al-wasfa attibbiya li yatimma taqdimuha fi makanin akhar.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Yumkin 2an tuwajjiha al itarat dhat al-3alama attijariya al-fakhira al-mutawaffira fi hadhihi al-manatiq mushkilatayn; qad yakunu ba3dhuha muzayafan, wa qad takunu al-muntajat al-7aqiqiya al-mustawrada aghla ladayna.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Al-qahwa hiya wa7ida min akthar assila3 tadawulan fil 3alam, wa qad tajid al-3adid mina al-anwa3 fi mintaqatik.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Wa ma3a dhalik, fa 2inna hunaka al-3adid mina atturuq al-mumayaza li-shurb al-qahwa 7awla al-3alam wa allaty tasta7iq attajruba.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Yatamathal tasalluq ashallalat (aw canyoneering bil ingliziya) fi dhahab ila qa3 wadi jaf aw mamlu2 bil-ma2.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Yajma3 tasalluq ashallalat bayna 3anasir mina assiba7a wa attasalluq wal qafz - wa lakinnaha tatatallab al-qalil nisbiyan min attadrib aw ashakl al-badani lil-bad2 (muqaranatan bi-tasalluq assukhur aw al-ghaws aw attazalluj 3ala jibal alpine, 3ala sabil al-mithal).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Al-mashy li-masafat tawila nashat fil hawa2 attalq yatakawwan min al-mashy fi bi2at tabi3iya, ghaliban 3ala masarat al-mashy li masafat tawila.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Tatadhamman riyadhat al-mashy li-masafat tawila fi annahar masafa taqillu 3an mile wa7id ila masafat atwal yumkin taghtiyatuha fi yawmin wa7id.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Lil-qiyam bi nuzha li yawm wa7id 3ala tul darbin sahl, yajibu al-qiyam bi-ba3dh al-isti3dadat, wa yumkin li ayi shakhs dhi liyaqa mutawassita al-istimta3 biha.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Qad ta7taj al3a2ilat allaty ladayha atfal sighar ila mazid min al-isti3dadat, wa lakin min assahl qadha2 yawm fil hawa2 attalq 7atta ma3a al-atfal arrudha3 wal atfal fi sin ma qabl al-madrasa.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: 3ala assa3id addawly, hunaka ma yaqrub min 200 munadhama siya7iya mustamirra fil 3amal. ya3mal mu3dhamuhum bi-shaklin mustaqil.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Yarbit Go Running Tours, khalifat Global Running Tours, al-3asharat min muzawwidy khidmat Sightrunning fi arba3 qarrat.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Ma3a wujud 2usul li-jawalat al-jary bi-Barcelona fi madinat Barcelona wa jawalat al-jary bi-Copenhagen fi madinat Copenhagen, sari3an ma 2indhammat ila al-qa2ima jawlat aljary bi-Prague wa maqarruha madinat Prague wa ghayriha min al-jawlat.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Tujad ashya2 3idda yajib wadh3uha fil i3tibar qabla assafar ila ayi makan wa kadhalika 3inda assafar.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: 3indama tusafir, la tatawaqqa3 2an takuna al2umur "kama hiya fi watanik". Takhtalif al-2adab, wal qawa3id, wal at3ima wal murur, wa ssakan, wal ma3ayir, wal lugha wa ghayriha ila 7addin ma 3an al-makan alladhi taqtun fihi.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Hadha shy2un ya7taj da2iman ila wadh3ih fi 3ayn al-i3tibar, wa dhalik li tajannub khaybat al-2amal aw rubbama 7atta annufur min al-3adat al-ma7aliya al-muttaba3a lil-qiyam bil-2umur.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Ta2assasat wikalat assafar mundhu al-qarn attasi3 3ashar. 3adatan ma yakunu wakil assafar khayaran jayidan li-ra7alat tafuqu tajarib al-musafir assabiqa fima yata3allaq bi-ttabi3a aw athaqafa, aw allugha, aw adduwal munkhafidhat addakhl.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: 3ala arraghm min 2anna mu3dham al-wikalat musta3idda li-iijra2 al-7ujuzat al-3adiya, illa 2anna al-3adid min al-wukala2 yatakhassasun fi anwa3 mu3ayana min assafar aw nitaqat almizaniyat aw al-wijhat.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Qad yakunu min al-afdhal al-isti3ana bi-wakil 3adatan ma ya7jiz ra7alat mumathila li-ri7latik.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Alqi nadhra 3ala arra7alat allaty yurawwiju laha al-wakil, sawa2 3ala mawqi3 web aw fi wajihat matjar.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Idha kunta turid 2an tara al-3alam bi-thaman zahid, bi-sabab adharura, aw ka-2uslub 7ayat, aw li-tta7addy, fa-hunaka ba3dh atturuq lil-qiyam bi-dhalik.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Fil asas, tanqasim ila fi2atayn: imma al-3amal athna2 assafar aw mu7awalat al-7ad min nafaqatik. turakkiz hadhihi al-maqala 3ala hadha al-akhir.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Li 2ula2ika alladhyn yarghabun fi attadh7iya bi-rra7a wal waqt wal qudra 3ala attanabu2 li-khafdh annafaqat bil qurb min assifr, raji3 al-7ad al-2adna li-mizaniyat assafar.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Taftaridhu annasi7a 2anna al-musafirin la yasriqun aw yata3addawn 3ala mumtalakat al-ghayr aw yusharikun fil aswaq ghayr al-qanuniya aw attasawwul aw yastaghilluna al-akharin li-ta7qiq makasibihim al-khassa.
text_en: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: 3adatan ma takunu nuqtat taftish al-hijra hiya al-ma7atta al-2ula 3inda annuzul mina atta2ira aw safina aw markaba 2ukhra.
text_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Fi ba3dh al-qitarat al-3abira lil-7udud, tujra 3amaliyat attaftish fil qitar al-muta7arrik wa yajib 2an yakun ladayka huwiya sali7a 3inda rukub a7ad hadhih al-qitarat.
text_en: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Fi qitarat annawm allayliya, yumkin lil-mu7assil istilam jawazat assafar 7atta la taqta3a nawmak.
text_en: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Attasjil shart idhafy li-3amaliyat al-7usul 3ala atta2shira. fi ba3dh al-buldan, yajibu 3alayka tasjil 7udhurik wa 3unwanuk 7aythu tuqim lada assulutat al-ma7aliya.
text_en: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Qad yatatallab hadha al-2amr mal2 istimara lada ashurta al-ma7aliya aw ziyarat makatib shu2un al-hijra.
text_en: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Fil 3adid mina al-buldan allaty yujad biha mithl hadha al-qanun, tatawalla al-fanadiq al-ma7aliya 3amaliyat attasjil (ta2akkad min assu2al).
text_en: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Fi 7alat 2ukhra, la tushtarat 3amaliyat attasjil illa liman yuqimuna kharij amakin al-iqama assiya7iya. wa ma3a dhalik, fa 2inna hadha al-2amr yaj3al al-qanun akthar ghumudhan, lidha yanbaghy 2an ta3rifa hadha al-2amr musbaqan.
text_en: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Al-handasa ma3niya bi-tasmim al-mabany wa tashyidiha. Ghaliban ma takunu al-handasa al-mi3mariya lil makan 3amil jadhb sia7y fi 7addi dhatih.
text_en: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Ta7dha al-3adid mina al-mabani bi-manadhir jadhaba 3inda annadhar ilayha, wa yumkin 2an yakuna al-mandhar min mabna shahiq aw min nafidha musammama bi-mahara 3aliya 2amran ra2i3an.
text_en: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Tatadakhal al-handasa al-mi3mariya bi-shaklin kabir ma3a al-majalat al 2ukhra bima fi dhalika attakhtit al-7adhary wal handasa al-madaniya wal funun azzakhrafiya wa attasmim addakhili wa tasmim al-manadhir attabi3iya.
text_en: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Bi-annadhar ila bu3d mu3dham al-hunud al-7umr, lan tatamakan min al-3uthur 3ala 7ayat layliya duna attawajuh ila Albuquerque aw Santa Fe.
text_en: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Wa ma3a dhalik, fa 2inna jami3 al-kazinuhat al-madhkura a3lah taqriban tuqaddim al-mashrubat, wa al-3adid minha yajlib attarfih alladhy ya7mil 3alama tijariya (bi-shaklin asasy al-kazinuhat al-kabira allaty tu7it mubasharatan bi-Albuquerque wa Santa Fe).
text_en: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: I7dhar: 7anat al-mudun assaghira huna laysat da2iman amakin jayida li-zza2ir min kharij al-wilaya li-ttasakku3 fiha.
text_en: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Li sabab wa7id, yu3ani shamal New Mexico min mashakil kabira fil qiyada ta7t ta2thir al-ku7ul, kama 2anna tarkiz assa2iqin al-makhmurin murtafi3 bil qurb min barat al-mudun assaghira.
text_en: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Ta3rif al-jidariyat aw ashakhbatat ghayr al-marghub fiha bi-ism al-grafiti.
text_en: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Fi 7in 2annaha la tu3addu dhahira 7aditha, illa 2anna aghlab al-ashkhas rubbama yarbitunaha bi-takhrib ashabab lil-mumtalakat al-3amma wal khassa bi-istikhdam rashash attila2.
text_en: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Wa ma3a dhalik, yujad fil waqt al-7adhir rassamu algraffiti, wa fa3aliyat al-kitaba 3ala al-judran wal judran "ashar3iya". Ghaliban ma tushbih law7at al-kitaba 3ala al-judran fi hadha assiyaq al-a3mal al-faniya badalan min al-3alamat ghayr al-maqru2a.
text_en: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Yu3tabar ramy al-boomerang mahara sha2i3a yarghab al-3adid min assuya7 fi iktisabiha.
text_en: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Idha kunta turid 2an tata3allam kayfiat ramy al-boomerang allathy ya3udu ilayk, fa ta2akkad min 2anna ladayk wa7idan munasiban lil-3awda.
text_en: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Mu3dham anwa3 al-boomerang al-mutawaffira fi 2ustralya la ta3ud ila ramiha marra 2ukhra. mina al-afdhal lil-mubtadi2in 3adam mu7awalat arramy fi mahab arriya7
text_en: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Yatimmu tahy wajabt Hangi fi 7ufra sakhina ta7ta al-ardh.
text_en: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Taskhun al-7ufra min khilal al-7ijara assakhina bi-2ish3al annar, aw fi ba3dh al-amakin taj3al al-7arara al-jawfiya misa7a mina al-ardh sakhina bi-tabi3atiha.
text_en: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: I3tada sha3b al-hangi ghaliban 3ala tahy 3asha2 taqlidy mina almashwiyat.
text_en: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Tuqaddim al-3adid mina al-amakin fi Rotorua wajabat hangi tutha bil-7arara al-jawfiyya, fi 7in yumkin akhdh 3ayinat 2ukhra min wajabat hangi fi Christchurch, Wellington wa amakin 2ukhra.
text_en: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: Lada Metrorail fi2atan min qitarat arrukkab fi Cape Town wa 7awlaha: Metroplus (wa tusamma aydhan addaraja al-2ula) wa Metro (tusamma addaraja athalitha).
text_en: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: Tu3adu Metroplus akthar ra7a wa aqal izdi7aman wa lakin tazid taklifatuha qalilan, 3ala arraghm min 2annaha la tazal arkhas min tadhakir al-metro al-3adiya fi Europa.
text_en: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Ya7tawy kul qitar 3ala 7afilat MetroPlus wa Metro; 7afilat MetroPlus takunu da2iman fi nihayat al-qitar al-aqrab li Cape Town.
text_en: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Al-7aml min ajl al-2akharin - la tada3 7aqa2ibak ba3idan 3an nadharik, khassatan 3inda 3ubur al-7udud addawliya.
text_en: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: Qad tajid nafsaka mustaghallan fi naql mukhaddirat duna 3ilmik, mimma sayu2ddi ila tawritika fi mushkilat kathira.
text_en: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Yashmal hadha al-2amr al-intidhar fi assaf, idh yumkin isـtikhdam kilab sham al-mukhaddirat fi ayi waqt wa dun sabiq 2indhar.
text_en: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: Tutabbiq ba3dh al-buldan 3uqubat sarima 7atta bi-nnisba lil-ara2im al-murtakaba li-awwal marra; yumkinu 2an tashmal hadhihi al-a7kam bi-ssijn li-akthar min 10 sanawat aw al-2i3dam.
text_en: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Tu3addu al-amti3a allaty yaghib 3anha as7abuha hadafan li-ssariqa, wa qad talfit kadhalika intibah assulutat allaty taqlaq bi-sha2n attahdidat allaty tusabbibuha al-qanabil.
text_en: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: Fil manzil, bi sabb hadha atta3arud al mustammir lil jarathim al ma7alliyya, fa inna al i7timalat 3aliya jiddan annaka mu7assan dhidaha bil fi3el.
text_en: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Wa lakin fi ajza2 ukhra min al 3alam, 7aythu takun alka2inat albiktiryulujiya jadida bi nisba lak, fa mina al mumkin 2an tuwajih mashakel.
text_en: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Aydan, fi al manakhat al akthar dif2an, tanmu al-baktirya bi sur3atin akbar wa ta3ish li fatra atwal kharij aljism.
text_en: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Wa hakadha 2afat Delhi Belly, wa la3nat Fer3awn,wa entiqam Montezuma wal kathir min amthalihim.
text_en: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Kama howa al 7al ma3a mashakil al jihaz attanaffusi fi almanakhat al barida, fa inna al mashakil al ma3awiyya fi al manakhat al 7arra sha2i3atan ila 7addin ma wa fi mu3dham al 7alat takunu muz3ijatan bi shakl wadi7 wa lakinnaha laysat khatiratan 7aqqan.
text_en: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Idha kunta tusafir fi dawla namiya li awal mara - aw fi juz2 jadid min al 3alam - fa la tuqallil min sha2n assadma al thaqafiyya al mu7tamala.
text_en: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Laqad jara al-taghallub 3ala al-3adeed min al-musafireen al-mustaqirrin wal qadirin min 5ilal 7adathat al-safar ela al-3alam al-namy, 7aythu yumkinu idhafat al-3adeed mina att3deelat al-thaqafyati assaghirati bisur3atin.
text_en: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Khodh fi 3ayn al-i3tibar attabahi bi nnamat al gharbi wal fanadiq dhat al jawda al gharbiyya wal ta3am wal khadamat lil musa3ada fi atta2aqlum, la siyyama fi ayamik al 2ula.
text_en: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: La tanam 3ala martaba aw mikhadda 3ala al ard fi almanatiq al lati la ta3rif fiha al 7ayawanat al ma7aliyya.
text_en: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Idha kunta tanw attakhyim, a79ir ma3ak sarir takhyim aw 2urju7a shabakiya li ib3adik 3an aththa3abin wal 3aqarib wa ma ila dhalik.
text_en: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Imla2 manzilaka bi qahwa ghaniyya saba7an wa ba3d shay al babunij al muhaddi2 fi laylan.
text_en: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: 3indama takun fi 3otla ma7alliya, yakun ladyka al waqet al kafi li tadlil nafsika wa kaseb al mazid min al waqet lil 3adid min al-ashya2 al-mumayyaza.
text_en: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: idha kunta tash3ur bi mazid min almughamara, fa ightanim alfursa li 3amal 3asir aw khalt al3asa2ir:
text_en: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: rbma stkt4f e7da alm4rwbat albsy6t wymknk e3dadh ltnawl alef6ar 3ndma t3wd ela rwtynk alywmy.
text_en: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: idha kunta ta3ish fi madina biha thaqafat shurb mutanawi3a, fa idhhab ila al7anat almawjuda fi al a7ya2 alty la tataradad 3alayha.
text_en: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Bi nisba li 2ula2ika aladhina laysu 3ala diraya bi almustala7at altibiya, fa inna kalimat almu3diya wa alsariya laha ma3ani mukhtalifa.
text_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.
