text: Al marad almu3di huwa al marad aladhy yusabibuh a7ad al3awamil almumarida, mithl alvirusat aw albiktiria aw alfetryat aw altufayliyat al ukhra.
text_en: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Almarad al mu3di  howa marad yantaqil bi sohala 3an tariq attawajud bi alqurb min shakhs musab.
text_en: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Tashtaret al 3adeed min al 7ukumat 3ala azzuwar al-ladhin yadkhulun buldanaham aw al-muqimin al-mughadirin an yatalaqqaw luqa7at al 3adid min al-amrad.
text_en: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Qad ta3tamid hadhihi al-mutatallibat ghaliban 3ala al-buldan al lati zaraha al musafir aw al lati yanwi ziyarataha.
text_en: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: I7da niqat al quwwa fi madina Charlotte, bi wilayat Shamal Carolina, hiya annaha tatamatta3 bi wifra min al khayarat lil usar wal 3a2ilat.
text_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Ghaliban ma yadhkur al-muqimun fi manatiq ukhra anna assabab al asasi lil intiqal ila huna huwa al jaw al 3a2ili, wa ghaliban ma yajid al zuwwar al madina mumti3a ma3a al atfal.
text_en: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Wa 3ala mada al 3ishrin sana al madiya, nama 7ajem al khayarat al mula2ima lil atfal fi mintaqat Uptown Charlotte bi shaklin kabir.
text_en: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: La tst5dm al 3a2ilat fi Charlotte sayyarat al ujra bi wajeh 3am, 3ala arraghim min annaha qad takun mufida fi dhuruf mu3ayyana.
text_en: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Hunaka taklifa idafiyya li wujud akthar min rakibayn, lidha qad yakun hadha al khayar aghla min al-lazem.
text_en: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antarkatika hiya abrad makan 3ala wajh al ard, wa hiya tu7itu bil qutb aljanubi.
text_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Tu3addu azziyara assiya7iya muklifa, wa tatallab liyaqa badaniyya, wa la yumkin ann tatim illa fi fasel assayf min Tishrin aththani 7atta Shubat, wa taqtasiru ila 7addin kabir 3ala shibih al jazira wal juzur wa ba7er Ross.
text_en: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Ya3ishu huna alaf al muwadhafin fi ssayf fi 7awalai arba3in qa3ida mu3zamoha fi tilka al manatiq; yabqa 3adadun qalil khilala fasl ashshita2.
text_en: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: Al qarra al janubiyya addakhiliyya hiya 3ibara 3an hadaba mahjura tughattiha masa7a min al jalid tatarawa7 bayn 2 wa 3 km.
text_en: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Tadhhab al-jawlat al-jawwiyya al-mutakhassisa ila addakhil, min ajel tasalluq al jibal aw lil wusul ila al qutub al ladhi ladayhi qa3ida kabira.
text_en: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Yaqa3 tariq al qutub al janubi (aw attariq assari3) 3ala msaft 1600 km min qa3idat McMurdo 3ala ba7er Ross ila al qutub
text_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Innaha thuluj madghuta ma3a shuquq mamlu2a wa mu3allama bil a3lam. Wa la yumkin assafaru ilayha illa bi wasitat al jarrarat al mutakhassisa, wa sa7eb azzallajat bil wuqud wal imdadat.
text_en: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Hiya laysat dhakiyya lil ghaya, lidha yajeb an ya2khud al masar in7irafan tawilan 7awla jibal Transantarctic lil wusul ila al hadaba.
text_en: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Yu3addu assabab al akthar shuyu3an li wuqu3 al 7awadith fi ashshita2 huwa atturuqat wal arsifa azzaliqa wa la siyyama al daraj.
text_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Ka 7ad adna, anta bi 7aja ila a7dhiya bi ni3al munasiba. 3adatan ma takun al a7dhiya alsayfiya zaliqa lil ghaya 3ala aljalid wal thalej, 7atta anna ba3e9 al a7dhiya alshitwiya takun 9a3ifa.
text_en: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Yajeb an yakun annamat 3amiq bi darajatin kafiya 5 mm (1/5 inchan) aw akthr, wa an takun al madda layyina bi shakil kafin fi darajat 7arara barida.
text_en: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Ta7tawi ba3e9 al a7dhiya 3ala masamir wa hunak mu3iddat idafiyya mujahhaza li 7alat al inzilaq, wa munasiba li kul al a7dhiya wal ku3ub wal ni3al.
text_en: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Yajib 2an yakuna al ka3b munkhafidan wa wasi3an. Ghaliban ma yatanathar arraml aw al 7asa aw al mil7 (chloride alcalcium) 3ala alturuq aw almasarat li ta7sin al i7tikak.
text_en: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Al inhiyarat althaljiyya laysat 7alat shazza. Al mun7adarat shadidat al in7idar yumkin an tabqa bati2a lil ghaya, wa tankhafid al a7jam alza2ida 3ala shakl inhiyarat thaljiyya.
text_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Tatamththal al mushkila fi anna aththalij yakunu lazijan, lidha ya7taju ila ba3id al mu7affizat li sa7bihi, wa ba3ed al thalej al ladhi tamma sa7buhu yumkin an yakun mu7affizan li ma tabaqqa.
text_en: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Fi ba3d al a7yan yakun al 7adeth al asli huwa anna darajat 7arart ashsha,es tatasabba fi taskhin aththalej, wa a7yanan al mazid min tasaqut aththalej, wa a7yanan a7dath tabi3iyya ukhra aw insaniyya.
text_en: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Al i3sar howa 3amud dawwar min hawa2 munkhafid addaght lil ghaya yamtassu alhawa2 almu7it ila addakhil wa ila al a3la.
text_en: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Tuwalled riya7 3atiya (a7yanan 100-200 mil bissa3a) wa yumkinuha an tarfa3 ashya2 fil hawa2, wa ta7miluha ma3aha.
text_en: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Tabda2 ka mamarrat tahbut min al ghuyum al 3asifa, thumma tusbi7 "a3asir" 3inda lamsiha lil ared.
text_en: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Yu3addu muwaffer khadem VPN ashshakhsi (asshabaka al iftiradiyya al khassa) tariqa mumtaza lil ta7ayol 3ala arraqaba assiyasiyya wal tasfiya ajjo8rafiyya attijariyya li brotokol al internet IP.
text_en: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Tatafawwaq 3ala mawqe3 al wakil (proxies) li 3iddat asbab: innaha tu3id tawjih kul tadaffuq al bayanat 3alal internet, wa laysa faqat brotokol http.
text_en: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Tuqaddim 3adatan nitaqan taradudiyyan a3la wa judat khidma afdal. Wa takun mushaffara mimma yas3ub attajasus 3alayha.
text_en: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Takdheb al sharikat al i3lamiyya 7awla al gharad min dhalik, muda3iyatan annhu "li tajannubu al qarsana".
text_en: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Fi 7aqiqat al amer, la tata2aththar rumuz al manatiq bi annasikh ghayr al qanunu, sa ya tim tashghil nasikh mushabih lil asliy 3ala ay jihaz.
text_en: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: Yatamaththal al hadaf al 7aqiqiy fi mane7 hadhihi ashsharikat haymantan akbar 3ala aswaqiha; kul ma fil amer rebe7 al amwal.
text_en: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Nadharan li anahu yatimmu tawjih al mukalamat 3aber al internet, falan ta7taj ila istikhdam sharikt hatif taqa3 fi al makan al ladhi ta3ish fih aw 7aythu tusafir.
text_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Kama la yajid ay mutatallibat tata3llaq bi 7usulika 3ala raqam ma7alliy min al mujtama3 al ladhi ta3ishu fih, wa yumkinuka al ettisal bil internet 3abra al aqmar assina3iyya fi barari mintaqat Chicken fi Aalaska, aw ikhtiyar raqam yusarri7 bi annaka fi Arizona al mushmisa.
text_en: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Ghaliban yajib 3alayka shira2 raqam 3alamiy munfasil yasma7 li hawatif PSTN bil ittisal bika. Al makan al ladhi ya2ti minhu arraqam yu7dithu farqan fil ashkhas al ladhin yattasiluna bika.
text_en: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Tatbiqat mutarjim alnusus fil waqet al fi3iliy- hiya tatbiqat asba7at qadira 3ala tarjamat ajza2 kamila min alnnas min lugha ila ukhra bi shaklin 2aliy.
text_en: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Yumkinu li ba3e9 attabiqat fi hadhihi al fi2a tarjamat nsus bil lughat al ajnabiyya 3ala al isharat aw al ashya2 fil 3alam al waqi3iy, 3indama yuwajjihu al mustakhdim jihazahu na7wa hadhihi al ashya2.
text_en: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Tatawwarat mu7arrikat attarjama bi shaklin jayyed, wa asba7ath tu3ti al yawm tarjamat sa7i7a ila 7addin ma aw aqal (wa nadiran ma takun attarjama rakika) illa annahu yajib ana tatawakhkha al 7adhar li2annah qad takun qad takun asabat al ma3na bi shaklin khata2.
text_en: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Yumaththil tatbiq 'Google Translate' a7ad ashhar attatbiqat fi hadhihi al fi2a, wa la ladhi yasma7 bi tarjama ghayr mutasila bil internet ba3da tathbit bayanat al-lugha al matluba.
text_en: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Qad yakun istikhdam tatbiqat almla7t 3abra nzam ta7did al mawqe3 al 3alami (GPS) 3ala hawatifikum adhdhakiyya huwa attariqa al ashal wal aktthar mula2ama lil tanaqul 5arej baladika.
text_en: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Min al mumkin tawfir al mal li shira2 5ara2et jadida li nidham GPS, aw jihaz GPS aw isti2jar wa7id min sharikat ta2jir assayarat.
text_en: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Idha lam yakun ladayka ittisal bayanat fi hatifik, aw 3indama yakun kharij nitaq attaghtiya, fa qad yakun ada2uhu ma7dud aw ghayr muta7.
text_en: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Kul matjar mawjud fil zawiya mali2 bi majmu3a mu7ayyira min bitaqat al itisal al madfu3a musbaqan al lati yumkin istikhdamuha min al hawatif al 3umumiyya aw al hawatif al 3adiyya.
text_en: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Fi 7in anna aghlab al bitaqat tusli7u lil etisal bi ay makan, yata5assasu ba3duha fi taqdim as3ar ma3qula li mukalamat majmu3a mu7addada min adduwal.
text_en: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Ghaliban ma yakunu al wusul ila hadhihi al khadamat min khilal raqm hatif majjani yumkinu al itisal bihi min mo3dhm al hawatif duna muqabil.
text_en: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Tantabiqu al qawa3id al muta3alliqa bil taswir aydan 3ala tasjil al vidyo wa rubbama akthar min dhalika.
text_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Idha kana mujarad iltiqat sura li shay2in ma ghayr masmu7 bihi, fa la yajib 2an tufakira 7ata fi tasjil maqati3 vidyo.
text_en: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Idha kunta tastakhdim ta2ira bidun tayyar (drone), fa ta7aqaq musbaqan mimma yusma7 laka bi taswirihi wa ma hiya attasari7 aw attarakhis al idafiya al matluba.
text_en: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Da2iman ma yakunu atta7liq ta2ira bidun tayar bil qurb min matar aw fawq 7ashd min annas fikra sayyi2a, 7atta law lam yakun dhalika mukhalifan lil qanun fi mintaqatik.
text_en: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Fil waqet al 7ader nadiran ma yatim 7ajez assafar al jawwi mubasharatan 3abra shirkat attayaran min dun al ba7eth awwalan 3an al as3ar wa muqaranatiha.
text_en: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Fi ba3e9 al a7yan mumkin an takhtalif talifat arri7lat nafsiha ila 7ad kabir fi majmu3at mukhtalifa, wa min al mufid muqaranat nata2ej al ba7eth wa elqa2 nadhratan 3ala mawqe3 al web al khas bi sharikat attayaran qabla al 7ajez.
text_en: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Fi 7in annka qad la ta7taj ela ta2shira lil ziyarat al qasira ila ba3i9 adduwal ka sa2i7 aw lil 3amal, fa enna adhdhahab ila hunaka ka talib duwali 3ammatan yatatallab iqama tawila akthar min dhahabika ka sa2i7 3adiy.
text_en: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: Tatallab al iqama, bi shaklin 3am, fi ay balad ajnabiy li fatra tawila al 7usul 3ala ta2shira musbaqan.
text_en: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: Tatallab ta2shirat attulab bi shaklin 3am shurut wa ijra2at taqdim mukhtalifa 3an ta2shirat assuyya7 aw rijal al a3mal al 3adiyya.
text_en: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Bi nisba li mu3dham albuldan, sata7taju ila khitab 3ard min a lmu2asasat al lati targhab fi addirasa biha, wa kadhalik dalil 3ala al amwal li da3m nafsika lil sana al 2ula 3ala al 2aqal min dirasatik.
text_en: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Ta7aqaq min al mu2asasat, wa kadhalika qism al hijra lil balad al ladhi targhab fil dirasa fih lil 7usul 3ala ashshurut bi sura mufassala.
text_en: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: Ma lam takun diblumasiyyan, fa enna al 3amal fil kharij fi 3umum al amer ya3ni annahu yajeb 3alayka taqdim daribat addakhel fi addawla al lati tuqim biha.
text_en: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: Tunadhdham daribat addakhel bi shaklin mukhtalif fi mukhtalaf al buldan, wa takhtalef mu3addalat addara2eb wa shara2e7 addaribiyya bi shaklin kabir min balad ela akhar.
text_en: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Fi ba3e9 al buldan dhat annidham al-fidrali mithil al Wilayat Al Mutta7ida wa Kanada, tufradu daribat addakhil 3ala kul min al mustawa al fidrali wal ma7alli, lidha yumkinu an takhtalifa mu3addalat addara2eb wal shara2e7 min mintaqa ela ukhra.
text_en: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Baynama yaghib ijra2 attftish al khas bil hijra 3adatan aw yakun ejra2an shakliyyan 3inda wusuluka ila watanika, yumkin an takun muraqabat al jamarik masdar ez3aj.
text_en: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Ta2akkad mimma yumkinuka taqdimuhu wa ma la yumkinuka taqdimuhu wa e3lan 3an ya shay2 yat5atta al  7udud al qanuniyya.
text_en: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: Ashal tariqa lil shru3 fi i7tiraf majal al kitaba 3an qita3 assafarhiya istithmar maharatika fi a7ad al mwaqe3 al khassa bi mudawanna 7awla hadha al qita3.
text_en: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Ba3da an ta3tad 3ala attansiq wal ta7rir 3ala al web, yumkinuka la7iqan insha2 mawqi3ika al khass.
text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Yu3addu al 3amal attatawu3iy athna2 assafar tariqatan ra2i3atan li i7dath farq, wa laken la yata3allaq al amer bil 3a6a2 fa 7aseb.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Yu3addu al 3aysh wa ttatawwu3 fi baladin ajanabiy tariqa ra2i3a lil ta3arruf 3ala thaqafa mukhtalifa, wal iltiqa2 bi askhkhas judud, wa ktishaf nafsika, wa ta3llum i7tiram wujhat annadhar, wa ktisab maharat jadida.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Min al mumkin an takuna aydan tariqatan jayyida li ziyadat al mizaniya lil sama7 bi iqama atwal fi makanin ma, nadharan ila anna al 3adid min al waza2if attatawwu3iyya tuwaffir sakan wa wajbat ta3am wa 3adad qalil mnihum yadfa3una rawatib qalila.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Estakhdamat shu3ub al Vikings atturuq al ma2iyya Arrusiyya lil wusul ela al ba7er al aswad wa ba7er Qazwin. Wa la yazalu min al mumkin istikhdam ajza2 min hadhihi al masarat. T7aqqaq min mada al 7aja al mu7tamala lil 7usul 3ala tarakhis khassa, wal ladhi qad yakun min assa3ib al 7usul 3alayha.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: Tarbitu qanat al ba7er al Abyad wal Baltiq bayna al mu7it al mutajammid ashamali wa ba7er al baltiq 3abra bu7ayrat Onega, wa Ladoga wa Saint Petesburg, wa yatimmu dhalika ghaliban 3an tariq al anhur wal bu7ayrat.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Tartabitu bu7ayrat Onega bi naher Volga, lidha fa inna al-ma2 al ladhi ya2ti min ba7er Qazwin 3abra Russya la yazalu wusulahu mumkinan.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Kun mutma2innan anahu bi mujarad wusulik ila al marasi, sayakun kol shay2 wadi7 jiddan. Sawfa tuqabil mutanazzihin akharin bil qawarib wa sayusharikuna ma3lumatihim ma3ak.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Fil asas, satada3u ikhtarat ta3arid fiha musa3adatak, tatakhata a7wad assufun, wa taqtarib min al ashkhas al ladhin yunazifun yukhutahum, wa tu7awil al itisal bil ba7ara fi al barr, ila akhirih.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: 7awel atta7aduth ela akbar 3adadin mumkin min al askhkhas. Ba3da fatratin sa ya3rifuka al jami3 wa yu3tuka nasa2e7 bisha2en al qareb al ladhi tab7athu 3anhu.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Yajib 3alyka an takhtar sharikat attayran al lati tusafir ma3aha kathiran fi ta7aluf bi shaklin daqiq.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: 3ala arrughum min annaka qad ta3taqidu annahu min assahl al indimam ila sharikat attayaran al-lati tusafir ma3aha kathyran, yajib an tudrik anna al imtiyazat al muqaddama ghaliban ma takun mukhtalifa wa anna niqat al musafir adda2im qad takunu akthar skha2an fi dhil sharikat tayaran mukhtalifa fi nafs atta7aluf.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Qamat sharikat attayaran mithl tayaran Al Imarat, wa Al Iti7ad lil tayaran, wa Alkhutut Aljawiya Alqataria, wa Alkhutut Aljawiya Alturkiyya bi tawsi3 nitaq khadamatiha ila Ifriqiya bi shakel kabir, kama annaha tuwaffir rawabit lil 3adid min almudun al Ifriqiyya al kubraa bi as3ar tanafusiyya muqarantan bi sharikat attayaran al orobiyya al ukhra.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Tuwajjih al Khutut al Jawwiya Atturkiyya ri7lataha ila 39 wujha fi 30 balad Afriqiy min 2014
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Idha kana ladayka waqt safar idafi, fa ta7aqaq min muqaranat assi3r al ijmali li Afriqya bil si3r 7awla al3alam.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: La tansa idafat altakalif al idafiyya lil ta2shirat al idafiyya wa dara2ib almughadara wa alnaql albariy wa ma ila dhalika li jami3 tilka al amakin kharij Ifriqya.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Idha kunta targhab fil safar 7awla al3alam bi alkamil fi nisf alkura aljanubi, fa innna ikhtiyar alra7lat wa alwijhat ma7dud bi sabb 3adm wujud turuq 3abr almu7it.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: La yughatti ay ta7aluf min sharikat attayaran jami3 ma3abir al mu7it aththalatha ( wa la yughatti SkyTeam ayyan min al ma3aber).
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Wa m3a dhalik, fa inna Star Alliance tughatti kul shay2 bi istithna2 sharq janub almu7it alhadi min Santiago de Chile ila Tahiti, wa hiya ri7la LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Hadhihi arri7la laysat al khiyar al wa7id idha kunta turid takhatti janub al mu7it al hadi2 wa ssa7il al gharbi li Amerika al janubiyyah . (Undhur adnah).
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Fi 3am 1994, shanna iqlim Nagorno- Karabakh al Armaniy 7arban didda al Azariyyin.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Tamma insha2 jumhuriyyah jadida bi da3men min al Arman. Ella annahu la yujad dawla qa2ima wa la 7atta Arminya ta3tarifu biha rasmiyyan.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Yuwasil aljadal al diBlomasi 7awla al mintaqa fi ifsad al3alaqa bayna Armenia wa Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Mintaqat al Qanat (Bil Hollandiyya: Grachtengordel ) hiya al mintaqa ashshaira al lati ta3udu ila al qaren assabi3 3ashar wal lati tu7itu bi markaz madinat Amesterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Sunnifat al mintaqa bi akmaliha ka mawqa3in turathiy 3alamiy tabi3 lil UNESCO, bi fadli thaqafatiha al farida wa qimatiha attarikhiyya, wa ta7tallu munsha2atuhu ta7tallu qimat assadirat al a3la bayna al-musha2at addawla al ukhra.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre, al lati ta3ni khams aradi, tadumu khams qura sa7iliyya saghira hiya Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza wa Monterosso alwaqi3a fi mintaqat Liguria al Italiyya.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: 2udrijat fi qa2imat al UNESCO lil Turath Al 3alami.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Wa 3ala mar al qurun, bana annas tarrasat bi 3inaya 3ala al manadhir attabi3iyya al wa3ira wa shadidat al in7idar wusulan ila al mun7adarat al mutilla 3ala al ba7er.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Yumaththilu jiz2an min si7riha al iftiqar ila attatwir al mu2assasi al mar2i. Wa tarbut al qitarat wal qawareb al quran, wa la yumkin lil sayyarat al wusul ilayha min al kharej.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Takhtalifu lahajat al-lugha al-Fransiya al-mustakhdama fi Beljika, wa Swisra ikhtilafan 6afifan 3an tilka al-mustakhdama fi Fransa, bi raghem min al-tashaboh al-kafi baynhunna lil sama7 bi fihmiha.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Wa 3ala wajeh al-khsus, ya7tawi nidham attarqim fi kul min Beljika wa Swissra al-natiqatayn bil Fransiyya, 3ala ba3ed al-khasa2es al-lati takhtalif 3an al-Faransiyya al-mu3tamada fi Faransa, wa yakhtalifu nitqu ba3edh al-kalimat ikhtilafan basitan.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Wa ma3a dhalika, fa enna jami3 al-Baljikiyyin wal Swisriyyin al-natiqin bil Faransiyya sa-yata3allamun al-Fransiyya al-qiyasiyya fil madaris, lidha sa-yakunun qadirin 3ala fehmika 7atta en stakhdamata nidham attarqim al-Faransy al-qiyasi.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Fi manatiq 3adida min al-3alam, attalwi7 lil akharin hiya 7araka widdiyya ta3ni "Mar7aban"
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Wa m3a dhalik, fa fi Malizya, 3ala al-aqal bayna al-Malayu fi al-manatiq arrifiyya, fa hadha ya3ni "t3ala", 3ala ghirar al-sabbaba al-mun7aniya tijah al-jisim, wa hiya 7araka tustakhdam fi b3dh al-buldan al-gharbiyya, wa yajib istikhdamuha faqat li hadha al-gharad.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Wa bil mithil, qad yartakib a7ad al-musafirin al-Bri6aniyyin fi Esbanya 5a6a2 3inda al-talwi7 bi yadihi lil wada3  wal lati tatdhamman ra7at al-yad al-lati tuwajih al-shakhes al-ladhi yulawwi7 (badalan min attalwi7 lil shakhes al-muqabel) ka ishara lil 3awda.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Al-lughat al-musa3ida hiya lughat mus6ana3a aw mabniyya tamma insha2uha bi qasd tashil attawasul bayna al-shu3ub al-lati qad tuwajih su3uba fil tawasul bi tariqa ukhra.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Wa hiya tanfasel 3an al-lugha al-mushtaraka, wa hiya lughat tabi3iyya aw 7ayawiyya, asba7at musay6ira  li sabab aw li akhar ka wasila lil tawasul bayna al-muta7addithin bi lughat ukhra.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Fi 5idhem an-nahar, yumkinu lil musafirin tajrubat as-sarab al-ladhi yuhim bi wujud al-miyah (aw ashya2 ukhra).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Qad yakun dhalika khatiran idha sa3a al-musafir wara2 as-sarab, wa ehdar a66aqa al-thamina, wal miyah al-mutabqqiya.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: 7ata as-sa7ari al akthar sukhuna yumkinu 2an tusbi7a shadidat al-buruda fil layl. Wa yu3tabar in5ifad 7ararat al-jism 5a6aran 7aqiqiyyan bidun irtida2 malabis dafi2a.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Fi fasel as-sayf wa 3ala wajeh al-5usus, yajeb an tatwa55a ashad al-7adhar min al-ba3udh idha qarrarta al-tanazzuh 3abra al-ghabat al-matira.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: 7atta law kunta taqud sayyaratak 3abra al-ghabat al-matira shibih al istiwa2iyya, fa inna bidh3a thawani ma3a fat7 al abwab athna2 dukhulik as-sayyara waqunt kafi lil ba3udh li rukub as-sayara ma3ak.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Anfelwanza a66uyur yumkin 2an tusib a66uyur wal thadiyyat.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Tamma al-iblagh 3an aqal min alef 7ala bayna al-bashar, lakin b3dhaha kana qatilan.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Laqad tadamman mu3dham al-ashkhas al-3amilina fi tarbiyat addawajin, wa lakin hunaka aydan ba3d al-ma5atir 3ala muraqibi a66uyur.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Yu3addu wujoud al-widyan al-5alaliyyah wal widyan chadidat al-in7idar fi Nawrwij min al-2umur al-mu3tada, wa hiya takchifu faj2atan 3an wujud hidab murtafi3a bichaklin aw bi 2a5ar.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Ghaliban ma yushar  ela hadhihi al-hidhab bi isim "vidde" mimma ya3ni masa7a wasi3a wa maftou7a bila ashjar, wa masa7a la 7udud laha.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: Fi muqata3atay  Rogaland wa Agder, 3adatan ma yutliqum 3alayha "hei" wa lati ta3ni ared mustanqa3iyya khaliya min al-ashjar, ghaliban ma takun mugha6at bil khalnaj.
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Al-anhar al-jalidiyya laysat thabita, wa lakinnaha tatdaffaq na7wa asfal al-jabal. Wa sa-yu2addi dhalika ela 7uduth tashaquqat, wa shuquq qad ta7jubuha jusur al-jalid.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Qad tanhar judran al-kuhuf al-jalidiyyah wa asqufuha, wa qad  tanghaliq ashshuquq.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: 3inda 7affat al-anhar al-jalidiyya, tatafakkak kutal dakhma, wa tasqut wa rubama taqfidh aw tatada7raj ba3idan 3an al-7affa.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Yablugh al-mawsim assiya7i dhurwatahu li ma7attat attilal khilal assayf al-Hindi.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Wa m3a dhalik, fa inahum yatamata3un bi naw3 mukhtalif min al-jamal wa al-si7ir khilala fasl ashita2, 7aythu yatalaqqa al-3adid min ma7attat al-tilal kammiyyat si77iyya min athalj wa tuqaddim anshita mithl attazalluj 3ala athalij wa attazaluj 3ala aljalid.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: La yazal 3adad qalil faqa6 min charikat attayaran yuqaddimun as3ar tadhakir al-muwasat, mimma yu9allil bi-shakel basit min taklifat assafar li 7udur al-jana2ez fil la7dhat al-akhira.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Tashmalu sharikat e66ayaran allati tuqadim hadha: Al-khutut Al-jawiyya Al-kanadiyya, wa khutut Delta al-jawiyya, wa Lufthansa lil ra7lat al-qadima min Al-Wilayat Al-muta7ida aw Kanada, wa WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Fi jami3 el-7alat, yajib an ta7jiza 3abr al-hatif mubacharatan ma3a charikat e66ayaran.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
